"Twenty-two realms compared to twenty-six realms, so this universe has four more stages than ours."

Xuanyuan Yue fell into contemplation. "If I think about it again, the strength of the primordial beings in this universe is higher than Aunt Huang, Mother Shen, and the other immortals. If Aunt Huang doesn’t have her ability to control time, I’m not sure if she can defeat Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, let alone defeat Feng Yao."
"Is Feng Yao really that strong, Master?"

"I can’t gauge Feng Yao’s true strength, but I feel that her strength should be on par with my father’s current strength or even higher." Xuanyuan Yue displayed images of her father and Feng Yao on the screen. "The only thing that differentiates them is my father’s chaos element, but I have a feeling that she’s stronger than him if they were to fight head-to-head."
"Does that mean Feng Yao can defeat your father?"
"If my father fights against Feng Yao without using his chaos element, I’m sure he will lose to her."
"How can you be so sure of that, Master?"

"A hunch." Xuanyuan Yue looked at Feng Yao on the screen. "Ever since Zhang Fei met Feng Yao, she has never used her true strength, but her avatar made Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi terrified. Huli Chenying nodded slightly. "By the way, the other difference between Zhang Fei and us lies in the Qi within our bodies, Master. Although our two universes were born because of Tang Xiao, the Qi differs between them. Compared to our universe, the Qi in this universe is more untamed."

"That’s right," Xuanyuan Yue sighed. "Actually, it’s not just our two universes that have different types of Qi, Sister Chenying. The Qi in the three other universes is also different from each other, and the Qi in the main universe is the weakest."
"What do you think is actually happening? Why do the five universes have different Qi from each other?"
"I don’t know." Xuanyuan Yue shook her head. "If we want to know the truth, we have to go to the Tower of Eternity."
Huli Chenying raised an eyebrow. "You mean we have to look for that mysterious man?"

"That’s right." Xuanyuan Yue changed the image on the screen again. "See? That mysterious man is the embodiment of Tang Xiao’s will left behind in this universe, and he should have the answer to our question."
"The embodiment of Tang Xiao’s will in our universe is your father, right?"

Xuanyuan Yue nodded slightly. "Based on past stories, the embodiment of Tang Xiao’s will in our universe resided in my grandmother’s womb, and it fused with my father when she was pregnant. That’s why Chaos chose him as his successor in the past, and he managed to defeat him because of it."
"How about we go to the Tower of Eternity now?"
"Let’s go."

In the blink of an eye, Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying arrived at the Tower of Eternity. They immediately activated their cultivation and leisurely strolled through all the challenges on the first floor.

The people on the first floor were shocked by Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying’s sudden appearance, but none of them dared to approach the two women. They were confused because the two women could walk so casually, and all the challenges on the first floor were inactive.

Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying ignored them, and they went straight to the second floor. Like on the first floor, all the challenges on the second floor were also inactive, allowing them to reach the third floor without any obstacles.

A few minutes later, Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying were standing in front of the gate on the third floor. The former touched the gate and tried to summon the mysterious man who met Zhang Fei in the past.
"Hmm?" Huli Chenying looked at the black shadow above the gate. "So, you are the embodiment of Tang Xiao’s will, right?"
The mysterious man gazed at the two women. "Why do you ask that when you already know the answer?"
"Why do the five universes have five different types of Qi?" Xuanyuan Yue asked.

"Unfortunately, I don’t have the answer to your question, little girl from another universe." Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying raised their eyebrows. "I am indeed the embodiment of his will, but my true self doesn’t know about it, so I can’t give you the answer."
Xuanyuan Yue wasn’t disappointed. "My second question is about you."
"Me?" The mysterious man pointed at his own face.
"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue nodded. "I don’t know about his will in the other two universes, but his will in my universe has been fused with my father since he was still a fetus."
The mysterious man was taken aback. "Is that true?"
"Do I need to lie to you?" The mysterious man shook his head at Xuanyuan Yue. "What about you? Will you continue wandering this universe? Or will you merge with Zhang Fei someday?"
"I don’t know."

"If you don’t merge with Zhang Fei, this universe will probably be destroyed in the future." The mysterious man squinted his eyes. "Oh, come on! You already know the facts about the core creature, and you should be able to guess the final result, right? In my opinion, you are the only one who can save this universe, but you cannot do it alone, and you must merge with him. If you merge with him, he can stop the core creature, like my father stopped Chaos in the past."
The mysterious man sighed. "I can’t decide on that for now, and I will wait until his cultivation breakthrough to the Three God Realms first."

"I see." Xuanyuan Yue nodded in understanding. "You told Zhang Fei that the owner of the Void Emperor Physique lived in the void core, and I already knew the Primal Origin Physique was in that sacred place, but you didn’t tell him about the possessors of the last four physiques."
"Do you want to know the identities and locations of the owners of the last three physiques?"
"Yes!" Xuanyuan Yue nodded vigorously. "In my opinion, the possessors of the four physiques would be valuable allies for Zhang Fei, so I want to know their identities and locations."

"Zhang Fei had already encountered the possessor of the Immortal Sacred Physique, but since it was in a dormant state, neither he nor Feng Yao realized it." Xuanyuan Yue raised an eyebrow because she was always monitoring Zhang Fei’s movements and developments. "The owner is Puyang Shenmi."
"Huh?" Both Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying were taken aback. "The ancestor of the Puyang Clan?"
"That’s right." The mysterious man nodded. "Unfortunately, Puyang Shenmi couldn’t awaken that physique, so it had been in a dormant state for a long time."
"What should we do to awaken that physique?"
"There is nothing we can do to awaken that physique; she has to awaken it herself."
Xuanyuan Yue thought about it for a while, and she came up with some ideas to help Puyang Shenmi awaken her special physique. "What about the other three?"
"The owner of the Universe Tree Physique is a male dryad, and he lives in the Xuanhuang Domain, which is about three months’ journey from the Myriad Abyss Domain."
"The Xuanhuang Domain," Xuanyuan Yue muttered to herself.
"The owner of the Heavenly Calamity Physique is the female demon in the Lotus Limbo World, and the owner of the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique is a young male fox named Hu Hunzi."
Xuanyuan Yue did not expect the owner of the Heavenly Calamity Physique to be the female demon who lived in the Lotus Limbo World. "Where does Hu Yunzhi live?"

"He lives with Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, and Zhang Fei will meet him when he goes to that domain in the future." The mysterious man didn’t understand why Xuanyuan Yue wanted to interfere in matters within the universe. "I’ve been out for too long, so I should leave now. However, I must remind you not to interfere too deeply in the affairs of this universe, or the consequences will be fatal."
The mysterious man didn’t wait for the two women’s answers and disappeared immediately.
Huli Chenying looked at her master. "It seems there’s nothing we can do to help Zhang Fei, Master."
"Not really," Xuanyuan Yue thought for a while. "Let’s go, Sister Chenying. We have to go to the Puyang Clan, and we will meet Puyang Shenmi there."
"Are you going to tell Zhang Fei about Puyang Shenmi, Master? Perhaps he has a solution to help her awaken her special physique."
"Before I tell Zhang Fei about the matter, we have to meet Puyang Shenmi first."
"Let’s go then."

Some time later, Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying arrived at the Puyang Clan, and they went straight to the sacred ground. Normally, no outsiders could enter that place, but the two women were different from the cultivators in that universe.

paragraphs: Huli Chenying smiled playfully, walked over to Puyang Shenmi, and sat down beside her. "Little girl, we came without any malicious intentions, so you don’t need to be wary of us."

Puyang Shenmi stared at Huli Chenying dumbfounded. After all, she was already too old, and only a few people addressed her as a little girl, including Feng Yao. She observed the female fox for a moment, but she couldn’t detect her cultivation, indicating that she was much stronger than him.
Judging from her bone age, Puyang Shenmi was able to confirm that Huli Chenying was much older than her, making her think that she was a primordial being like Feng Yao. "Do you—"

"No." Huli Chenying interrupted her with a shake of her head. "I’m not a primordial being, but I’m much older than you. Besides, you should have noticed that the Qi inside my body is different from yours, right?"
"That’s right." Puyang Shenmi nodded. "Then—"
Huli Chenying pressed her fingers against Puyang Shenmi’s sensual lips. "There are some things we cannot discuss with others, so you need not ask about them."

"We came to examine something inside you, Shenmi." Puyang Shenmi looked at Xuanyuan Yue, but her expression changed as soon as she realized that the young girl in front of her was stronger than Huli Chenying. "By the way, I am familiar with Zhang Fei, and I also know that Puyang Yeyu is your descendant, so you don’t need to be afraid of us."
Puyang Shenmi was quite surprised to hear that. "Can you tell me your name?"
"Call me Yue." Xuanyuan Yue grabbed her hand. "Please let me check your body, and we will leave after that."
"Alright." In the next second, Puyang Shenmi felt Xuanyuan Yue’s qi flowing through his body, and it gave her a strange feeling due to the difference in their qi. "How could your Qi be like this?"
Xuanyuan Yue looked at her with a smile. "Just think that we are different from other cultivators, including Feng Yao."
Xuanyuan Yue’s vague answer left Puyang Shenmi feeling uneasy, but she could see that the young girl in front of her clearly had no intention of telling her anything. "Have you ever met Senior Feng?"
"My mother and I met Feng Yao once a few years ago." Xuanyuan Yue waved her hand and created a qi screen, displaying their first and last meeting.
Seeing their encounter with Feng Yao, Puyang Shenmi felt a little relieved in her heart. On the qi screen, she could see that their meeting was very warm, and Xuanyuan Yue was also joking with her.

A while later, Xuanyuan Yue had already withdrawn her qi and released Puyang Shenmi’s hand. "I wanted to tell you that you have something interesting inside your body, but unfortunately, you can’t awaken it. At first, I came here to help you awaken it, but I couldn’t do it due to the difference in our qi."
"Something interesting?"
"Yes." Xuanyuan Yue nodded. "To be precise, it’s the Immortal Sacred Physique."
"What?" Puyang Shenmi screamed, her eyes wide open. "You... you mean the rank 5 physique—the Immortal Sacred Physique?"

Huli Chenying’s lips curled up. "What? Are you shocked to hear that? The Immortal Sacred Physique is one of the most special physiques in the universe, and you are truly fortunate to possess it. If you can awaken that physique, your cultivation will probably be able to break through to the Three God Realms."

"That’s impossible." Puyang Shenmi shook her head. "Senior Feng once told me that no cultivator in the Ancient Realm can break through to that stage, and we must go to the Primordial Realm to break through."
Huli Chenying looked at Xuanyuan Yue, who nodded at her.

"Feng Yao told you the truth, Shenmi. The universe limits cultivation levels in this Ancient Realm, so no cultivator can break through to that stage." Xuanyuan Yue thought while looking at Puyang Shenmi, but then she spoke again. "If you want to break through to that stage, I can take you to the Primordial Realm, but you won’t be able to return to this realm again."

Puyang Shenmi took a deep breath; her eyes trembled with excitement. Her cultivation had long since reached the Celestial God Realm, and she hoped to break through to the Three God Realms after Feng Yao informed her about them. However, she hurriedly suppressed her excitement because her Puyang Clan was still facing danger, and she couldn’t abandon her clansmen. "Thank you for your offer, but I have great responsibilities towards my clan, so I cannot go with you."
"I understand." Xuanyuan Yue pulled Huli Chenying to her feet. "I’ve gotten the answer to my question, so the two of us will leave now."

Puyang Shenmi was speechless because Xuanyuan Yue and Huli Chenying disappeared just like that, and she couldn’t stop them. She closed her eyes and checked her body, but she couldn’t feel the Immortal Sacred Physique in her body.
After giving it some thought, Puyang Shenmi stepped out of the sacred ground, sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei, and then returned inside.
"I can’t detect that physique within my body, but Senior Feng should be able to, right?" Puyang Shenmi shook her head slightly. "If she could do it, why didn’t she tell me during our last meeting?"
Puyang Shenmi let out a soft sigh, closed her eyes, and thought of many ways to awaken her special physique.

Luckily, Xian Xian, Tang Ying, Jing Qiuyue, Meng Qi, Meng Guanqiu, Ju Yingzhi, Xin Yanluo, Feng Xueling, and Feng Jinqiu were training at the training ground with the others.
Apart from Tang Ying, Meng Qi, and Xin Yanluo, Zhang Fei knew that the other six women had long been in love with him.
However, he still hadn’t accepted them into his harem for some reason.
Among those women, Zhang Fei had absolutely no interest in Meng Guanqiu, and he allowed her to cultivate in the pavilion at Meng Qi’s request.
"Shenmi."
Hearing the call, Puyang Shenmi abruptly opened her eyes; she was slightly surprised when Guang Zhiyi appeared before her.
"Senior?
Why do you use this form?"
"This is just a projection of the memories I left behind in the past."
Puyang Shenmi nodded in understanding.
"What brought you here today, Senior?"
"I heard from someone that you possess the Immortal Sacred Physique, so I came to see you to check."
"Who exactly is that young girl?
Why is her qi different from ours?" Puyang Shenmi was bothered by that.
Guang Zhiyi thought for a moment.
"Her name is Xuanyuan Yue, and she is not a resident of our universe."
"Huh?" Puyang Shenmi gasped in shock.
"You mean?"
"Xuanyuan Yue came from another universe, and she came to our universe to find a way to free her father." Guang Zhiyi’s answer shocked Puyang Shenmi further.
"Actually, I’ve long been aware of the existence of other universes, but I couldn’t confirm it.
Several years ago, she and her mother came to see me, and their appearance answered everything."
Puyang Shenmi’s mind was muddled; she didn’t expect that universes existed.
Moreover, a young girl from one of those universes had come to their universe, which was difficult to believe.
Guang Zhiyi smiled.
"Actually, that young girl had an unusual relationship with Zhang Fei, and she changed his fate."
"Zhang Fei?"
"That’s right," Guang Zhiyi told Puyang Shenmi about Zhang Fei and Xuanyuan Yue’s relationship.
"If it weren’t for her, he would never have become a cultivator, and the fate of this universe would never have changed.
However, I’m worried that the change will be different from what I expected."
Puyang Shenmi took a deep breath.
"What will happen to our universe?
Can it still be saved?"
"I don’t have the answers to your questions." Guang Zhiyi took Puyang Shenmi’s hand and examined her body.
"The future of this universe rests on Zhang Fei’s shoulders; whether the outcome is good or bad, we will see in the future."
Puyang Shenmi didn’t disturb Guang Zhiyi, who was still concentrating on examining her body.
She herself was curious about the Immortal Sacred Physique, but she couldn’t find it in her body.
After a few minutes, Guang Zhiyi withdrew her hand and looked at Puyang Shenmi.
"That young girl was right; you do possess that physique.
However, I cannot help you awaken it because this is not my true body, and my true body cannot return to this realm since my cultivation has already reached the Supreme God Realm."
"Then, what should I do to awaken my special physique?
Should I break through to the Three God Realms first?
Actually, that young girl offered to take me to the Primordial Realm, but I rejected her offer."
Guang Zhiyi raised her eyebrows.
"I understand your concerns for your Puyang Clan, but you should have accepted her offer, Shenmi.
Since you’ve rejected her offer, we’ll have to use other methods to awaken your physique, but I’ll discuss this matter with my husband first."
"Does that mean Zhang Fei can awaken my special physique?"
"Perhaps he can help you awaken your special physique." Guang Zhiyi sighed softly, as she had no solution to help Puyang Shenmi without her real body.
"You don’t need to think about that now, and I will ask him to come here when he has time."
Puyang Shenmi nodded.
"Alright, I’ll wait for him, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: Zhang Fei - Puang Shenmi - Puyang Yeyu
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5], who was hunting mindless demons, immediately stopped when Feng Yao asked him to enter the beast space.
After they sat down opposite each other, Feng Yao explained Puyang Shenmi’s situation to him, which surprised him quite a bit. "I can’t help her awaken her Immortal Sacred Physique."
"Does that special physique usually need to be awakened? Shouldn’t it awaken on its own?"

"All special physiques need to be awakened, Husband." Feng Yao created a qi screen. "See? Luo Yunxiao was able to awaken her Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique because of the help of one of Hu Tianlang’s souls; otherwise, it would still be dormant. If I remember correctly, Zhuxian Sheng inherited his Ancestral Battle Saint Physique from his late master, who was a member of the Shizu Clan."

"You were right about them, Yao’er." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "The old fox helped Luo Yunxiao awaken her special physique, and Zhuxian Sheng’s special physique has been active ever since he inherited it from his late master. So, what should we do to help Puyang Shenmi awaken her special physique? And what are the advantages of the Immortal Sacred Physique?
"Semi-immortality." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "Although Puyang Shenmi possesses the Immortal Sacred Physique, she will never become immortal, but she will gain many benefits once it awakens."
"For example?"

"Her skeleton, flesh, meridians, and others will become stronger, allowing her to withstand tremendous attacks. She will also gain regeneration abilities like Jiu Tou Sen’s, so she will not die easily. A single drop of her blood can nourish a dying cultivator or heal severe injuries. She will gain immense life force, giving her an extraordinarily long lifespan. Her physique will provide an exceptionally stable foundation for cultivation, making breakthroughs easier and reducing the risk of cultivation deviation."
"So many benefits," Zhang Fei [5] muttered with awe.

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "The Immortal Sacred Physique is ranked fifth out of the ten special physiques, remember? My Immortal Reincarnation Physique doesn’t have as many advantages as Puang Shenmi’s special physique, but it allows me to reincarnate without losing my strength. Since I am the reincarnation of a primordial being, my physique is enough for me."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Luo Yunxiao’s Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique allows her to manipulate all kinds of things in the universe, including Yin and Yang Qi. Zhuxian Sheng’s Ancestral Battle Saint Physique allows him to increase his fighting ability severalfold. What are the advantages of the Myriad Dao Physique?"
"The main advantage of that physique is that its owner can comprehend all the daos in this universe, including the dao of life, the dao of death, and many others."

Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath after Feng Yao mentioned that. After all, comprehending the daos was one of the most difficult things, and he had experienced it himself when he tried to comprehend the sword dao and other daos in the past.
Zhang Fei [5] remembered another special physique. "What about Hu Hunzhi’s Yin-Yang Devouring Physique?"

"The main advantage of the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique is that its owner can absorb both Yin and Yang Qi simultaneously, so his cultivation is much faster than that of most cultivators, including dual cultivators."
"Oh? He can absorb Yin Qi without dual cultivating?"
"The owner of that physique is a dual cultivator by nature, but he doesn’t need to dual cultivate."

Zhang Fei [5] couldn’t help but be jealous of Hu Yunzhi, as he could absorb the Yin and Yang Qi in the universe. If he had that physique, his five clones would not need to absorb Yin Qi from those female Yin demons; they could absorb it while doing various other activities. That way, he wouldn’t have to waste time, and his cultivation would improve much faster.
Feng Yao continued, "You should be able to guess the advantages gained by the possessors of the Universe Tree Physique and the Void Emperor Physique, right?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "The advantages of the Universe Tree Physique should be related to the wood element, and the advantages of the Void Emperor Physique should be related to the void element."

"Those two special physiques are closely related to the two elements." Feng Yao changed the image on the QI screen. "The Heavenly Calamity Physique is the most dangerous among the ten special physiques, Husband. Luckily, the owner of the physique cannot leave the Limbo Lotus World, or else calamity will fall in all domains."
Zhang Fei [5]’s expression turned serious. "Is that the reason Old Fox didn’t dare to fight that female demon in the past?"

"No," Feng Yao denied with a shake of her head. "In the past, Hu Tianlang possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique, and his abilities surpassed those of the female demon. With all his advantages, he could defeat her easily; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to leave that damn place. However, she definitely holds a grudge against him, and she will wreak her revenge on you in the future because you are his sole heir."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled bitterly upon hearing that, yet he was not overly afraid of that female demon. Moreover, he would not enter the Lotus Limbo World alone in the future, and Luo Yunxiao would accompany him there. "What do you think if I go look for the owner of the Universe Tree Physique? Since his special physique has such advantages, he should be able to help Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang speed up the development of my soul world."
"For now, you should focus fully on your cultivation and seclusion, Husband. After you complete your seclusion, you can go to his domain together with Long Xukong."

Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Feng Yao because breaking through each stage in the Five Celestial Realms was too difficult; he needed an enormous amount of qi. Even with his current number of wives and his five clones, he couldn’t break through as quickly as in the past, so he couldn’t waste too much time.
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly. "Back to the matter of Puyang Shenmi’s special physique, what should we do to help her awaken it?"

"Perhaps her special physique will awaken if you dual cultivate with her, Husband." Zhang Fei [5] coughed a few times. "Hahaha! Why do you react like that? Puyang Shenmi is beautiful, isn’t she? If you take her as your wife, you can have a threesome with her and Puyang Yeyu."
"Am I that lustful, Yao’er?"

"Don’t you already know the answer?" Feng Yao turned the question around with a mocking smile. "If Puyang Shenmi becomes your wife, the Puyang Clan will become your vassal, and you will gain many additional powerful cultivators as your subordinates."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "I will go to my training space to pick up Puyang Yeyu, and I will take her to meet her grandmother."
"Alright."
A few moments later, Zhang Fei [5] and Puyang Yeyu were already inside the sacred ground of the Puyang Clan, and they immediately met Puyang Shenmi at the end.
When they arrived, they found Puyang Shenmi chatting with Guang Zhiyi, who was a projection of Feng Yao’s past memories.
"Grandmother."
Puyang Shenmi looked at her granddaughter longingly. "Your cultivation will likely break through to the next stage soon, Yeyu."

"You’re right, Grandmother." Puyang Yeyu sat next to her grandmother. "I have always cultivated using my husband’s yang qi, and I have also long mastered the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique. Besides, the flow of time in his private place is several times faster than in the outside world, so my cultivation can improve faster. Unfortunately, I still need more time to reach the Celestial God Realm like you, so I can only be patient for that."
"Haha," Puyang Shenmi patted her granddaughter’s head. "Be patient and cultivate more diligently; you will reach that stage in the future."
Puyang Yeyu nodded with a smile. "I didn’t expect you to possess the Immortal Sacred Physique, and my husband has already told me about the many benefits of that physique."
"Unfortunately, my special physique is still dormant, and Senior Feng has no solution to awaken it." Puyang Shenmi looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Can you help me awaken my special physique?"
Zhang Fei [5] approached Puyang Shenmi, transformed into his half-fox form, and grabbed her hand. "I don’t know if I can help you awaken it, but I’ll try first."

Puyang Shenmi felt uncomfortable with Zhang Fei [5] holding her hand, but she did not reject him and allowed him to examine her body. Guang Zhiyi had already told her about all the benefits of the Immortal Sacred Physique, and she was eager to awaken it.

Soon, Puyang Shenmi could feel the flow of Zhang Fei [5]’s qi in her body, and it gave her a strange sensation. Even though he used his half-fox form, his lust demon form still affected his qi. However, the effect wasn’t very strong unless he used his lust demon form.
After a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] withdrew his qi and released Puyang Shenmi’s hand, relieving her. He looked at Guang Zhiyi and shook his head. "I can’t awaken her special physique."
"Try using that thing." Guang Zhiyi looked at Puyang Shenmi and asked. "Are you willing to try it?"
Puyang Shenmi became awkward as soon as Guang Zhiyi mentioned it. Zhang Fei [5] was her granddaughter’s husband, and she felt uncomfortable swallowing his yang qi.

Puyang Yeyu took out a bottle from her storage ring and handed it to her grandmother. "You should swallow it, Grandmother. Your special physique has many advantages, and you will become much stronger if you successfully awaken it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1907: Take Puyang Shenmi To Train
paragraphs: After giving it some thought, Puyang Shenmi took the bottle from Puyang Yeyu’s hand, removed the lid, and tasted it. To her surprise, she didn’t feel disgusted by it, and she could feel the power of Zhang Fei [5]’s yang qi.

Although Zhang Fei [5]’s cultivation was only at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, Puyang Shenmi felt that his yang qi was much stronger than she had initially imagined. Without the slightest hesitation, she swallowed it clean, and her body slowly heated up.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly touched her forehead and imparted the Flawless Yin-Yang Arts to her, allowing her to cultivate his yang qi.

After considering it, Zhang Fei [5] decided to impart the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique and the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique to her. In addition to the previous three techniques, he gave her the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art, which would help her increase her soul power.
Puyang Shenmi stared at him in surprise, as all of these techniques were precious, yet he gave them to her.
"What do you feel now?"
Puyang Shenmi examined her body and shook her head. "I can sense the power of your yang qi in my body, but I can’t sense any signs of my special physique activating."
"That’s weird." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Guang Zhiyi. "What should we do next?"

Guang Zhiyi supported her chin with one hand and looked at Puyang Shenmi. "The Immortal Sacred Physique is special, and she has only swallowed your Yang Qi once, so its effects are not yet visible. Let her try swallowing it for a few days, and we’ll see the results then."
"What do you think about that?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Puyang Shenmi.

Puyang Shenmi actually didn’t want to swallow his yang qi too often; she was afraid of being addicted to it. However, she is so eager to awaken her special physique, but unfortunately, she has no solution. "I will try it."
"In that case, I will take you to my private place; you can swallow my yang qi there, and you can also train with Yeyu there."

Puyang Shenmi didn’t want to leave the Puyang Clan with those creatures continuing to attack her clan, but Guang Zhiyi suddenly spoke to her. "You don’t need to worry about your clan, and I will protect it in your place. You can train there, but your main task is to awaken your special physique."
"Alright."
After Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal, Puyang Yeyu grabbed Puyang Shenmi’s hand and pulled her inside.
Zhang Fei [5] closed the portal and looked at Guang Zhiyi. "What if it still doesn’t work?"
"At least, we should try it first, and I’ll find another way if it doesn’t work."
"Sure." After that, Zhang Fei [5] returned to the Myriad Abyss Dungeon to continue collecting those demon materials.
Guang Zhiyi disappeared from that place, but she did not leave the Puyang Clan.
Upon their arrival at the training space, Puyang Shenmi was surprised to see so many cultivators from all races in the training ground.
Puyang Yeyu pulled her grandmother to an empty area and explained to her all the features in the training ground, from gravity features to several others.

Since she was an experienced cultivator with her cultivation at the Celestial God Realm, Puyang Shenmi was not interested in the battle simulation feature, but she was very interested in gravity, comprehension, and suppression features.
As for the timeflow feature, it is always active, which makes the flow of time inside the training space several times faster than in the outside world.

Moreover, Zhang Fei previously gave her some techniques, and Puyang Shenmi could use the comprehension feature to learn them faster. Among the four techniques, the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art Technique was slightly more difficult than the others, so she wanted to focus on it first.

"Grandma, you can start practicing using the gravity feature after you’ve learned all of those techniques, and I’ll bring your nine avatars to the room where my avatars cultivate." Puyang Yeyu was confident that Puyang Shenmi could reach the maximum level of the Nine Heavens Illusory Avatar Technique. "When you practice using the gravity feature later, you can also use the suppression feature, and it will make your soul even stronger."
Puyang Shenmi nodded in understanding before turning towards the pavilion. "Do Zhang Fei and all his wives live in there?"
"Yes." Puyang Yeyu pointed to several women in the training room. "They are his wives."

Puyang Shenmi looked at Liu Qingyu and several other women, who were training in several other areas of the training ground. She listened to her granddaughter explaining to her their identities one by one. She herself had heard that Zhang Fei had more than a hundred wives, so she wasn’t surprised to see them, but she was quite surprised to hear that some of them had familial relationships.
After that, Puyang Shenmi sat on the edge and began to learn all the techniques assisted by the comprehension feature, allowing her to master them more quickly.

In a short time, Puyang Shenmi managed to create nine avatars, which surprised her quite a bit. She was delighted to see her avatars because they could cultivate separately, and her body would absorb the results of their cultivation, which would accelerate her cultivation.
As previously planned, Puyang Yeyu brought her grandmother’s nine avatars to the room where hers cultivated, and she left them there.
A few days passed quickly, and Zhang Fei had already finished dual cultivation with Xu Ling’er and Wu Lianzhi. Like their sisters, the two women immediately left him to cultivate and practice.
Instead of stopping, Zhang Fei asked Ling Dong’er, Mu Lingshu, and Chang Wenjie to meet him in the main bedroom.
Among the three women, Ling Dong’er was the most indifferent to dual cultivating with Zhang Fei in front of several women.
Chang Wenjie was still a little reserved, but she didn’t refuse.

However, Mu Lingshu was different from them; she was still embarrassed to dual cultivate with Zhang Fei in front of her sisters. Unfortunately, she had no other choice but to join them because her other wives were still waiting for their turn.

"Husband." Zhang Fei looked at Lin Dong’er. "After we finish, I want to visit my father in the Sky Jade Realm. I haven’t seen him for so long, and he will definitely be shocked to see that I am older than him."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "I just remembered that you are older than your father."

Lin Dong’er pouted. "The time flow in your training space is so fast, and the time flow in the Sky Jade Realm is much slower than in the Paradise Realm. Unfortunately, my father has always been stubborn, and he is unwilling to leave that realm."

"After all, the Sky Jade Realm is your ancestral realm, so your father is unwilling to move out." Zhang Fei paused. "However, I already have other plans, and I will move all our relatives to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the future."
Lin Dong’er’s eyes lit up. "Are you really going to move them to that domain?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded. "The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley will be our second base in the future, and they can cultivate very quickly there."
"When will we move to the Sky Dragon Island, husband?" Chang Wenjie asked.
Zhang Fei looked at her. "Do you like the situation there, Wenjie?"
"I really like it!" Chang Wenjie nodded happily. "Sky Dragon Island is a vast floating island, and not many cultivators know about it, so I want to live there."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "After they finish building the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, I’ll have them rebuild Sky Dragon Island. I’ll also have Liao Hanxue install two defensive formations there. After we complete our seclusion, I’ll take you all to live there, and no one will disturb our lives there."

paragraphs: Cold sweat dripped from Qian Yu’s forehead; Qian Yan’s expression was too terrifying for him. He had never seen his father so furious before. "I didn’t see anyone infiltrating our domain, Father. I only discovered that Qian Hua and the others had vanished when I inspected their respective quarters."
"Is that so?" Qian Yan narrowed his eyes and observed his son. "If I find out you’re in cahoot with that bastard, I’ll feed you to my pets."

"Leave." After Qian Yu left, Qian Yan summoned several of his subordinates, and they had figures that were no less terrifying than him. "I don’t care how you will do it; you guys have to find the other demon domains as soon as possible."
"Demon God." Qian Yan looked at an old male demon. "I found Qi Qingxiu’s domain shortly after you left, but her domain was completely destroyed, and I couldn’t find any members of her race."

Qian Yan was shocked to hear that, and he immediately activated his middle eye to check Qi Qingxiu’s domain. Although he could inspect her domain from a distance, he couldn’t locate her after the massive changes that had occurred in the Paradise Realm all those years ago.
As his subordinate said, Qian Yan found Qi Qingxiu’s domain already in ruins, including her demon palace. "Do you know the cause?"
"I don’t know the exact cause, but—" The old demon paused for a moment. "But I detected Mo Shentian’s demon qi in her domain, so I thought he was the one who destroyed it."

"Mo Shentian?" Qian Yan furrowed his brows; he remembered the Celestial Demon God had returned to his domain about eight months ago. As far as he could remember, he had never had any problems with Qi Qingxiu, so he felt strange about his actions of destroying her domain. "Have any of you found the Celestial Demon Domain?"
An old female demon raised her hand. "Demon God, I have found the location of the Celestial Demon Domain, but I cannot enter the domain because Mo Shentian has activated the barrier."

"Hmm?" Qian Yan felt that there was something strange about that, and it was contrary to Mo Shentian’s character. He immediately checked the Celestial Demon Domain, but he felt strange after finding the Celestial Demon God shutting himself in seclusion. "What was he really thinking? Why did he destroy Qi Qingxiu’s domain?"

Another old male demon spoke to him. "Demon God, the location of Wu Mian’s domain is not far from Qi Qingxiu’s domain, but I feel that there is something strange about his domain, and all my subordinates disappeared as soon as they entered."

"Wu Mian has always been unpredictable, and none of us dare to underestimate him." Qian Yan inspected the Faceless Demon Domain, but he noticed something unusual, forcing him to retract his abilities. "Moreover, all the demon gods know that his body is not his real body, but no one knows where he hides his real body. As long as I can’t find his real body, I can’t get rid of him, so I don’t want to deal with him for now."
"What should we do now, Demon God?"

"Wait." Qian Yan checked the other six demon domains, but he couldn’t find Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran in their domains, which was truly unusual. However, he didn’t try to track down the two female demons elsewhere; instead, he checked the other demon domains. "I couldn’t find Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran, but I found Shang Zhanluo, Sha Mo, and Jiu Mozu in their respective domains."
"Are we going to hunt down one of them first, Demon God?"

"Shang Zhanluo and Sha Mo are much stronger than you, so I want you to hunt down Jiu Mozu and capture him for me. As long as you separate him from his nine subordinates, he won’t be able to fight you." Qian Yan thought for a moment before continuing. "However, you guys must be careful of Jiu Moze. He is much stronger than his disciple, and he can kill you easily. Meanwhile, I will go to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain, and I will capture the Heavenly Fiend Demon God myself."
"Have you found the location of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain, Demon God?"
"Heh!" Qian Yan smirked. "My relationship with Sha Mo has always been good; he will not hide the location of his domain from me! Leave now and capture Jiu Mozu for me!"
"We will leave now, Demon God."

After his subordinates left, Qian Yan contacted Sha Mo to ask about the location of his domain. As he expected, the Heavenly Fiend Demon God immediately told him the location of his domain, and he hurriedly left his palace. "I really want to kill that bastard! However, he has Empress Huo and that female flame spirit by his side, so I’ll capture the other demon gods and increase my strength first."

As soon as he left his palace, Qian Yan immediately stopped in his tracks and looked up at the sky, finding Huo Ling standing there. He shivered when he saw the evil grin on her face; he couldn’t forget their last battle in the Myriad Abyss Domain, which had left him severely injured.
Huo Ling smirked. "Are you that afraid of me, Little Beast? You’re lucky I didn’t come here to beat you up, and my husband sent me to tell you that he will challenge you to a fight in ten years."

"Hmm?" Qian Yan was taken aback. "I’m afraid of you, but I’m not afraid of your husband. Even if he cultivates for another thousand years, he will never be able to surpass me, and I will kill him in our future fight."
"Arrogant, aren’t you?" Huo Ling said mockingly. "For your information, my husband is still under a hundred years old, but his cultivation has already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm."
Qian Yan froze, his eyes wide with shock. "Impossible! There’s no way he could reach that stage in less than a hundred years!"

"Haha," Huo Ling laughed. "It might be impossible for you, but it’s not difficult for my husband. If he were an ordinary cultivator, do you think my master and I would be willing to become his wives?"
Qian Yan’s pupils dilated, his body trembling quite violently. He was familiar with Feng Yao’s character, and she wouldn’t have chosen Zhang Fei as her husband if he were an ordinary cultivator.
Moreover, Qian Yan knew Huo Ling was not an ordinary flame spirit, and she was much more arrogant than Feng Yao, yet she recognized Zhang Fei as her husband.
Huo Ling looked toward Qian Yan’s demon palace, extended her right hand, and shot a small flame toward it.
The small flame passed through the motionless Qian Yan, and a loud explosion rang out a moment later, followed by the sound of the building collapsing.
"This is my reward for insulting my husband." After saying that, Huo Ling immediately disappeared from the domain.

Qian Yan’s face turned furious; he clenched his fists beside his body, and all the muscles on his body bulged out. He turned around and saw his demon palace slowly collapsing, and Qian Yu led his other children to avoid the collapse.
"Father!" Qian Yu called out to his father, breathing heavily. "What exactly happened? Who attacked us just now?"

"After the flames are extinguished, order everyone to clear the rubble and rebuild my palace." Qian Yan’s eyes turned sharp. "I’m going to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain now, and I’ll be back in a few months. While I’m gone, you can take over leadership of our demon race, and I want to see everything in order when I return."
Qian Yan didn’t wait for his son’s answer, flew into the sky, and transformed into his beast form. He flew away from his domain at high speed, and his next destination was Sha Mo’s domain.
Qian Yu couldn’t understand his father; he turned around to see the collapsed demon palace engulfed in flame. ’Is this Zhang Fei’s doing? Doesn’t this mean he is openly challenging my father?’

A little distance away from the domain, Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling stood side by side, watching Qian Yan fly away so quickly. "If it weren’t for you, I would have killed that foolish demon beast god, husband."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Why are you so eager to kill him? To be honest, I’ve never thought about killing him, and I want to subdue him in the future."
"Why do you want to do that?"

"Ling’er, Qian Yan’s middle eye ability is terrifying, remember?" Huo Ling immediately understood Zhang Fei [5]’s intentions. "If I subdue him and make him my contract beast in the future, I can utilize his abilities to monitor the situation in the Ancient Realm much more easily, and I won’t have to spend so much time sorting out any trouble that might come our way."
"I get it." Huo Ling nodded. "Does that mean you’ll be going to all the domains in the Ancient Realm in the future?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] had been thinking about that matter ever since he arrived in the Ancient Realm, but he hadn’t had the time to do so yet, and he wanted to focus on his strength first. "Once I’m done with my seclusion, one of my clones will go to all the domains, and I can go wherever I want using my gate ability. By the way, we should head to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain now, and I’ll transfer them to another domain. After all, Sha Qingge is my future wife, so I won’t let her family and race members fall into Qian Yan’s hands."
"Let’s go then."

Shang Dongzhu’s decision made Shang Beixuan and the others gloomy, but none of them dared to express their opinions in the presence of Zhang Fei [5].
Shang Dongzhu was the strongest Asura Guardian, and Zhang Fei [5] defeated him easily nine months ago; even his injury had not fully recovered after several months of treatment.

Since they had already made their decision, Zhang Fei [5] didn’t say anything to them, nor did he warn them about Qian Yan. He always cared about those who chose to stand by his side, but he didn’t care about those who chose to stand against him.

After their preparations were complete, Zhang Fei [5] sent Shang Zhanluo and members of the Asura Demon Race to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and he asked Hua Qianmei to bring them to the Capital City. He had thought everything through carefully, and the best option for them was to live near Mo Qingwen.
After leaving the Slaughter Blood Domain, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Torture Demon Race Domain to meet Ku Shenzu and his family.

Although Ku Shenzu and his family were his slaves, Zhang Fei [5] did not plan to relocate them to the Myriad Abyss Domain. However, he warned them about Qian Yan’s movements and left a small amount of Primordial Flame in their domain.

After leaving the Torture Demon Palace, Zhang Fei [5] stood atop a hill, and Huo Ling immediately emerged from his body. "All your preparations are complete; you no longer need to waste time on trivial matters, and you can focus on your cultivation."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "However, I worry that their presence in the Myriad Abyss Domain will alert the other demon gods, and they might attack them."
Huo Ling shook her head helplessly. "If you’re worried about their safety, I’ll help you monitor the situation in the domain, and I’ll protect them for you."
"Thank you, Ling’er."

sentences.text: "Mother!"
Sha Yuan looked at her daughter, who was running toward her.
She saw Shang Xueli walking arm-in-arm with Zhang Fei [5], followed by Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan.
Sha Qingge leapt forward and hugged her mother.
"Hahaha!
I missed you so much, Mother."
"We last saw each other three days ago, remember?" Sha Yuan paused, sensing something different about her daughter.
"Have the two of you done the deed?"
"Ugh." Sha Qingge was too shy to talk about that.
"We just finished our short seclusion, and since he said his clone was going to our domain to meet my father, I asked him to bring me here."
Sha Yuan felt relieved upon hearing that; she was happy because Zhang Fei [5] and Sha Qingge had already sealed their relationship.
"My husband and son are not in the palace; they are currently arranging our demon race members in the plaza."
"Got it." Zhang Fei [5] removed his arm from Shang Xueli’s embrace.
"I’ll go meet them first, and you can wait for me here with Qingge."
Shang Xueli nodded.
"I’ll wait for you to come back."
After Zhang Fei [5] took Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan away, Shang Xueli joined Sha Yuan and Sha Qingge.
"Are you also his wife, Xueli?"
Shang Xueli shyly nodded to Sha Yuan.
"Qingge, Qian Qin, and I became his wives on the same day."
"Qian Qin?" Sha Yuan was surprised to hear that name from Shang Xueli.
Sha Qingge immediately explained Qian Qin’s situation to her mother.
"Since then, she has lived with him, and she became his wife at the same time as the two of us."
"I see." An absurd thought suddenly popped into Sha Yuan’s mind.
"Does that mean the three of you entered seclusion with Zhang Fei at the same time?"
Sha Qingge and Shang Xueli blushed.
"We just finished our seclusion, Mother."
"How long were you guys in seclusion before?"
"A few weeks."
"Oh?" Sha Yuan’s eyes lit up.
"Does that mean the three of you were constantly dual cultivating with him for weeks?"
"Ugh!" Sha Qingge was embarrassed to talk about it with her mother.
"Let’s not talk about that, Mother.
I will take Xueli to my room to pack my personal belongings; our husband will take us to the Slaughter Blood Domain after this."
After saying that, Sha Qingge took Shang Xueli’s hand and pulled her away to her room in the palace.
Sha Yuan watched them leave, deep in thought.
"A few weeks?
How is that possible?
The last time they were here was three days ago, right?"
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan stood beside Sha Mo and Sha Huo, with several grand elders of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race standing behind them.
Sha Mo informed Zhang Fei [5] about the number of members of their race and several other matters so his son-in-law could decide what was best for his race members.

Zhang Fei [5] discussed the matter with Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, and he decided to move all the members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race to the places the female Poisonous Demon God had prepared for them.
Zhang Fei [5] made that decision because members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race possess extremely high resistance to poison, so they should face no problems adapting to their new home.

Moreover, Hua Qianmei’s places were already occupied by members of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race and the Seven Emotion Demon Race, and those places would become too crowded if he also moved members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race there.
Since they were ready to move, Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Myriad Abyss Domain and asked Sha Mo to lead all the members of his race there.

Since the areas under her control were different from the others, Gongsun Zhilan decided to return to the domain with Sha Mo and the others; she was worried the members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race would face difficulties getting there.

Compared to the members of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race and the Seven Emotion Demon Race, the number of members of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race was much greater, and it took them some time to move to the Myriad Abyss Domain.

Hua Qianmei had already told Zhang Fei [5] that the Asura Demon Race also existed in the Ancient Realm, and they lived in another domain.

If Zhang Fei [5] moved Shang Zhanluo and all the Asura Demon Race members to that domain, the Asura Demon God of the Ancient Realm would suppress them, and that would only bring new trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1921: Demon Races On The Move II
paragraphs: "What do you think of this palace, Futian?"

Ye Futian surveyed the surroundings before replying to Ye Mingran. "Demon God, most of this castle was destroyed long ago, but the main foundation remains intact. If you wish to use it as your new residence, we can rebuild it."
"Yes." Ye Mingran nodded. "I have discussed this matter with my husband, and he agreed to rebuild this palace. However, I will not use it as my residence; I want to build it in another area."
Ye Futian looked at her, confused. "Then, who will live in this palace in the future?"

"This Endless Night Domain is the home of the Silver Moon Clan, and the soul of their leader resides in my husband’s soul world." Ye Futian had heard rumors about the domain owner, but he had never met the owner. "Her name is Yin Yue, and she is the true leader of the Silver Moon Clan. Even though she has lived in my husband’s soul world for quite a long time, her soul has not yet fully recovered, so she cannot reform her body yet."
Ye Futian nodded in understanding. "Does that mean Zhang Fei wants to help Yin Yue revive her Silver Moon Clan?"

"Yes." Ye Mingran nodded. "Besides the Silver Moon Clan, my husband will also help Tian Taiyang and Tian Shuying revive the Golden Sun Clan, but I don’t know his plans for the Zenith Solar Sanctum yet."
"Who are Tian Taiyang and Tian Shuying?"

"Tian Shuying is the ancestor of the Golden Sun Clan, and Tian Taiyang is one of the male elders of that clan." Ye Mingran retold Ye Futian about the past events between the Golden Sun Clan and the Silver Moon Clan, which ultimately destroyed both clans and their domains. "The three of them have forgotten the enmity between their two clans, and my husband is helping them to recover their soul power."
Ye Futian was truly shocked after hearing Ye Mingran’s story; he didn’t expect that the two ancient clans would be destroyed because of their overzealous ambitions.

Ye Mingran continued, "According to Feng Yao, both clans will be important to my husband, especially the Silver Moon Clan. Therefore, he wants to revive both clans, and they will be valuable allies for him in the future."
"I’m confused about one thing, Demon God."
"Tell me."

"Zhang Fei will have no trouble reviving the Golden Sun Clan because of Tian Taiyang’s existence, but I’m not sure he can revive the Silver Moon Clan, especially since its remaining member is a woman."

"Haha." Ye Mingran laughed softly. "Futian, you don’t know my husband very well, so you don’t know his true abilities. Even though Yin Yue is a woman, it’s not difficult for my husband to help her revive her Silver Moon Clan. Have you ever met someone who can turn other humans into beasts or demon beasts?"
"No," Ye Futian answered by shaking his head.
"See?" Ye Mingran smiled. "By the way, I haven’t told you about one important thing."
"What’s that?" Ye Futian’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Ye Mingran turned into a demon beast. "This? Qiongqi? How is this possible?"
Ye Mingran lowered his head and looked at him. "My husband used some parts of Qiongqi’s body to transform me into a demon beast, but my race is different from his."
"Then?"

Ye Mingran returned to her human form. "Even though my husband used some parts of Qiongqi’s body, my race is a combination of his demon beast race and my Eternal Night Demon Race. I inherited all his demon beast abilities, but I also retained all my demon abilities."
"Unbelievable!" Ye Futian took a deep breath. "Did Zhang Fei also use the other three evil beasts?"
Ye Mingran nodded. "Qi Qingxiu transformed into the Taotie demon beast race, Mo Zainan transformed into the Hundun demon beast race, and Nalan Wangzi transformed into the Taowu demon beast race."
"Then, what about the original four evil beasts?"

"They will die soon." Ye Futian remembered the incident in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain a few months ago, but he didn’t know Taotie and his three friends’ fate. "They were too stupid to follow Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi’s orders, and they suffered the consequences of their stupidity. When they die, the four of us will take their place, and we will lead the evil beast races."

Ye Futian felt Zhang Fei was too terrifying; he could even turn four women into the new four perils. Not only did they transform into the four evil beast races and inherit their abilities, but they also retained their original demon abilities.
Ye Mingran smiled when she saw his expression. "Becoming Zhang Fei’s wife is the best decision I have ever made in my life, Futian."

"You are right, Demon God." Ye Futian didn’t argue with Ye Mingran; he knew all of Zhang Fei’s actions since he ascended to the Paradise Realm, and his actions changed many things. "In that case, I will lead our subordinates to rebuild this palace, and I will also order them to build a new residence for you in this domain."

"You don’t need to rush to build a new residence for me." Ye Mingran looked ahead. "Fortunately, right now, I want you to focus on rebuilding this palace, and you can assign our subordinates to repair the other areas. However, you must forbid them from approaching the abyss; that place is quite dangerous for them."
Ye Futian nodded. "I understand; I will gather them now. However, this domain has been abandoned for a long time, so we need to take materials from our domain to rebuild everything."

"You don’t need to worry about the materials; my husband will send some other people from time to time, and they will also help in rebuilding this domain." Ye Futian nodded and left the palace, leaving Ye Mingran there. "What exactly is your grand plan, husband? Aren’t you going to bring everyone to live in your soul world in the future?"
Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Shizhe stood side by side, watching the members of their two races from a distance.
"Do you think the presence of our two races in this domain will bring trouble to Hua Qianmei, Qingxiu?" Nalan Shizhe asked worriedly.

"Perhaps." Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow. "However, we don’t need to worry about that, Shizhe. Before my husband decided to move them to this domain, he had already thought everything through carefully, including the possibility of future problems. Moreover, Hua Qianmei is much stronger than us, and her bewitching abilities cannot be underestimated. Several demon gods are also on Mo Qingwen’s side, and they have already anticipated the opposition’s actions."
"I hope you’re right." Nalan Shizhe exhaled softly. "I don’t want our presence here to bring trouble to Hua Qianmei, Qingxiu."

Unlike Nalan Shizhe, Qi Qingxiu responded to their situation casually. "If those ignorant demon gods dare to seek trouble with Hua Qianmei, I’m sure my husband will not let them go, and he will probably eliminate them once and for all."

Nalan Shizhe did not doubt Zhang Fei’s abilities; she believed he could eliminate all the demon gods hostile to those closest to him, either using his own strength or with the help of Huo Ling and Feng Yao.
Nalan Shizhe sighed. "We were born and raised in the Paradise Realm, but starting today, we will start our new lives in this domain."

"Haha," Qi Qingxiu laughed. "Look at the expressions on the faces of our Demon race members; they are overjoyed and impatient to start their new lives in this domain. Unfortunately, our ancestors did not have the opportunity to witness the future of our two races, but I believe they will also be happy with their changes."
"Has your ancestor left this world?"
Qi Qingxiu’s expression turned sorrowful. "She came to me a few years ago to say goodbye, and I never heard from her again after that."
"I see." Nalan Shizhe nodded in understanding. "My ancestor hasn’t contacted me in a long time, and I thought she had already left this world."
"If that’s true, only the ancestor of the Torture Demon Race remains, but strangely, he didn’t appear when my husband enslaved Ku Shenzu."
"That old man stopped caring about the members of his race long ago, and he is spending his time waiting for death."

In another area, Gongsun Zhilan explained many things to Sha Mo and Sha Yuan about the areas in her territory, and he warned them not to approach some areas there because the poison level there was too high.

Although the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race had high resistance to poison, Gongsun Zhilan was not confident they could withstand those poisons. After all, they were Zhang Fei’s parents-in-law, and he was her master, so she couldn’t let them die from those poisons.
"Can you tell us about the hostile demon gods?"

Gongsun Zhilan looked at Sha Mo in surprise. "Their leader is Huo Wuyan, and he should already know about Zhang Fei. Their activities have decreased slightly since Qian Yan’s appearance in this domain, but they will never stop their plans."
"How many demon gods are there in Huo Wuyan’s group?"

"In the past, there were only three other Demon Gods, but I heard Gui Ye has joined them as well." Gongsun Zhilan paused. "Cang Moyu and Zuo Hentian were previously in my group, but the two of them will likely join Huo Wuyan in the future. By the way, the two of you don’t need to interfere in the internal affairs of this domain, and I believe they will think twice about interfering with the lives of your race."
Sha Mo and Sha Yuan nodded in understanding; they believed Zhang Fei would not remain silent if those demon gods attacked them.
"I will leave now, and the two of you can organize the members of your race."
"Thank you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1922: Demon Races On The Move III
paragraphs: "Hahaha!"
When Hua Qianmei led Shang Zhanluo, Shang Luohu, Shang Xueli, and Shang Zhui into the palace living room, loud laughter greeted them.
Hua Qianmei did not recognize the voice’s owner, but Shang Zhanluo did. "Old Wu? Since when have you been in this domain?"
"Your son-in-law sent me to this domain before you, Old Shang." Wu Mian replied with a grin.
Hua Qianmei finally recalled who Wu Mian was, but she said nothing and looked at Mo Qingwen. "They are Zhang Fei’s wife’s family, and he asked me to bring them here."

"Wu Mian has already told me about them, and I have prepared a place for them." Mo Qingwen walked up to Shang Zhanluo and his family. "My name is Mo Qingwen, and I am the leader of this domain. By the way, you are the second Asura Demon God I have ever met."
Shang Zhanluo raised an eyebrow momentarily. "Is there an Asura Demon God in this realm, Senior?"

"Yes." Mo Qingwen nodded. "His name is Shang Jingyuan, and his strength is quite fearsome, especially when he uses his bloodline technique. Since you’re an Asura Demon like him, you should also possess that technique, right?"

Since Mo Qingwen already knew about it, Shang Zhanluo didn’t hide it. "I do have that technique, but I can’t use it for too long. If I force myself, all the nerves in my body will rupture, and I will become a cripple. Moreover, that technique is useless against cultivators stronger than me, like Zhang Fei."
"Oh?" Mo Qingwen was taken aback. "Does that mean Zhang Fei once defeated you?"
"He defeated me once, and I couldn’t fight him back then." Shang Zhanluo replied with a disappointed sigh.

Mo Qingwen patted his shoulder. "You don’t have to feel embarrassed for losing to Zhang Fei, Shanluo. He’s different from other cultivators, and I’m afraid of him myself. Are they your wife and daughter?"
"Yes." Shang Zhanluo introduced them. "Shang Luohu is my wife, and Shang Xueli is my daughter. The man behind us is my confidant, Shang Zhui."
"I’ve seen your daughter before." Gu Yanshu chimed in as she walked to her husband’s side. "You previously cultivated in Hua Qianmei’s secret place, right?"
Shang Xueli nodded. "Three months ago, my husband took us to cultivate there, Senior."

"I have a daughter, and she’s a little older than you. Unfortunately, she’s not here now, and she’s helping Zhang Fei collect those demon materials in the dungeon." Gu Yanshu took Shang Luohu’s hand. "Since you two are Zhang Fei’s parents-in-law, I’d like to invite you to stay in this palace, and the members of your race can stay in the quarters we’ve prepared for them."

"You’re pregnant, right?" Shang Luohu nodded to Gu Yanshu. "The domain looks safe from the outside, but the situation here is actually not safe. Since you’re in the early stages of pregnancy, you’ll be safer staying here. Moreover, that place isn’t far from this city, and you can visit them whenever you want."
Shang Luohu turned to her husband beside her. "What do you think about that, husband?"

"For the time being, you can stay here for the safety of you and our child in your womb, wife." Shang Zhanluo looked at Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu. "We just arrived at the domain today, so I will stay with my clan members to control the situation."
Mo Qingwen nodded in understanding. "I will order my trusted men to lead you and the members of your race to that place, and you can visit your wife whenever you want."
"Thank you, seniors," Shang Zhanluo said gratefully.

After all, they were newcomers to the Myriad Abyss Domain and were unfamiliar with the situation. Besides, Zhang Fei had also informed Shang Zhanluo that several other demon gods were trying to take down Mo Qingwen, which made the situation worrying.
"I will accompany my mother here, Father." Shang Xueli said.
"Alright." After Mo Qingwen’s subordinates arrived, he immediately led Shang Zhanluo and Shang Zhui away from the palace, and Wu Mian followed behind them.
"What about you, Qianmei? Are you going straight back to the dungeon?" Gu Yanshu asked.

Hua Qianmei shrugged. "Zhang Fei has dozens of demon wives, and the majority of them have not reached the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, so I will return to the dungeon to help him collect those materials."
"Alright." After Hua Qianmei left, Gu Yanshu led Shang Xueli and Shang Luohu away. "Please follow me."
They had only walked a step when Mo Cangyue suddenly ran into the room. "Oh? Why is she here, Mother? Who is the woman beside her?"
"Come with us, Cangyue." Mo Cangyue nodded to her mother and followed them. "Shang Luohu is Shang Xueli’s mother, so she is Zhang Fei’s mother-in-law."
"I see." Mo Cangyue nodded in understanding. "Welcome to our palace, Xueli and Auntie."
"Thank you."
Gu Yanshu looked at her daughter and asked. "Why are you suddenly back? Are you bored in the dungeon?"

"Yeah," Mo Cangyue replied gloomily. "I’ve been in the dungeon for a few months, so I decided to go back and rest. Once my boredom subsides, I’ll go there again. Since Shang Xueli is here, I’ll accompany her while I rest my body."
Gu Yanshu raised an eyebrow when she noticed the unusual look in her daughter’s eyes. ’Don’t disturb Xueli! Your father and I won’t be able to save you if Zhang Fei gets angry with you.’
’Humph! I never thought of bothering her!’ Mo Cangyue answered with a displeased look.

’Do you think I don’t know your character?’ Gu Yanshu’s tone became sharp. ’I know you’re upset with Zhang Fei because of Yuan Xiajie! I warned you not to disturb Shang Xueli, and I’ll lock you in your room if you dare to contradict me.’
Mo Cangyue pouted; she didn’t dare to contradict her mother. ’Tch! Because of Zhang Fei, Yuan Xiajie doesn’t want to be intimate with me anymore!’
Gu Yanshu could only shake her head; she felt powerless to change her daughter’s nature.
Before long, they arrived at the guest quarters, and Gu Yanshu showed Shang Xueli to her room. Afterward, she took Shang Luohu into another room to discuss the Asura Demon Race of the Ancient Realm.
Mo Cangyue pulled Shang Xueli into his room. "Hey, how did you fall in love with Zhang Fei?"
"My husband is my savior."
"Savior?"
"Yes." Shang Xueli nodded and told Mo Cangyue about her dark past, shocking her. "After he saved me from Mo Zixiao, he took me to his secret place, and I spent quite a long time there."
Mo Cangyue nodded slightly. "So, you fell in love with him because he saved you from your ex-husband?"
"No." Shang Xueli denied that. "Besides saving me, he also gave me many opportunities to improve myself, and I fell in love with him after we spent a long time together."
Mo Cangyue thought for a while before asking again. "Did he ever take Yuan Xiajie to his secret place? How was their relationship?

"Hmm?" Shang Xueli could hear the jealousy in Mo Cangyue’s voice. "You’re not wrong about that, and my husband took her to his secret place before, but I never saw them getting close. He spent his time with his other wives in his residence, and Yuan Xiajie focused on her training elsewhere."
Mo Cangyue didn’t know whether Shang Xueli could be trusted. After all, she was one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and she was definitely on his side. "Then, how did Yuan Xiajie fall in love with him?"
"Huh?" Shang Xueli blinked. "Honestly, I don’t know the depth of their relationship, but I’ve heard that they used to be enemies because she kidnapped Wang Yin in the past."
Naturally, Mo Cangyue had already heard about their past enmity, and she also knew that Zhang Fei found Yuan Xiajie in the Frozen Yin Domain before taking her to his secret place.
Shang Xueli observed her expression. "Did you fall in love with Yuan Xiajie, Cangyue?"

"Apart from my father and big brother, all men are trash, and they always think with their lower bodies, so I never like them." Shang Xueli’s eye twitched after Mo Cangyue said that. "I met Yuan Xiajie when Hua Qianmei brought her to this domain, and I’ve loved her ever since. However, her feelings changed because of Zhang Fei, and she even decided to give herself to him. I’ve asked for the details, but she was unwilling to tell me the truth."

"Honestly, I’m not surprised that Yuan Xiajie fell in love with my husband." Mo Cangyue’s face darkened, and her demon aura exploded, but Shang Xueli wasn’t afraid. "Even Senior Qianmei, Senior Zhiyao, and Senior Zhilan fell in love with him. By the way, I advise you not to make enemies with him; he has no mercy towards his enemies, including women. If you choose to be his enemy, you will suffer and regret it for the rest of your life."
"Humph!" Mo Cangyue snorted and turned to leave. "Yuan Xiajie is mine, and I will never hand her over to anyone, including Zhang Fei!"

Shang Xueli watched Mo Cangyue walk away with a shake of her head. "I don’t understand why a woman like her would choose to be a lily, especially since she’s always lived safely and comfortably in this palace. If she were ever in my position, she would probably have committed suicide long ago."

In another room, Gu Yanshu had a serious conversation with Shang Luohu. "Luohu, you must tell your husband to be careful of Shang Jingyuan. Sooner or later, I’m sure he’ll discover your presence in this domain, and he’ll come here to kill your husband."
"Why is that, Senior? Where did he get the information about our presence in this domain?" Shang Luohu asked in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1923: Demon Races On The Move IV
paragraphs: Gu Yanshu took a deep breath and explained a few things to Shang Luohu. "I don’t know much about your Asura Demon Race, but I am quite familiar with Shang Jingyuan. He is completely different from your husband, and he is extremely bloody. Have you ever heard of the ten strongest cultivators in the Ancient Realm?"
"I don’t know much about the Ancient Realm, so I’ve never heard of it." Shang Luohu paused. "However, my daughter might know about them, Senior Gu."

A light bulb seemed to appear above Gu Yanshu’s head as she remembered something. "Oh, that’s right! Your daughter is Zhang Fei’s wife, and she learned many things from Senior Feng. You should call her, and we’ll continue talking after she arrives."
"Alright." Shang Luohu agreed.
Not long after, Shang Xueli entered the bedroom, looking at her mother and Gu Yanshu in confusion. "Why did you call me, Mother?"
"Do you know anything about the ten strongest cultivators in this Ancient Realm, Xueli?" Shang Luohu asked.

"Oh." Shang Xueli nodded. "My husband told us about them before, Mother. The strongest among them is Jiu Tou Sen, followed by Meng Huo, Senior Mo Qingwen, and Long Yunxi. However, he didn’t mention the fifth to tenth strongest."
Shang Luohu was shocked to hear that Mo Qingwen was the third strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm.
"By the way, Long Yunxi is a demihuman and inherited the sky dragon bloodline; she has been living with us in my husband’s private place for a month and a half, and she is still there to this day."
Gu Yanshu wasn’t surprised to hear that from Shang Xueli because Mo Qingwen had already told her, but Shang Luohu was even more shocked about Zhang Fei’s relationship with those cultivators.
"Why do you ask that, Mother?"
Shang Luohu took a deep breath. "Senior Gu previously mentioned the ten strongest cultivators, and it has something to do with the Asura Demon God from this Ancient Realm."
"Hmm?" Shang Xueli looked at Gu Yanshu with a questioning look.
"Your mother is right, Xueli." Gu Yanshu nodded. "In the past, there were ten strongest cultivators in this Ancient Realm, but six of them are now dead, and one of them is Senior Feng Yao."
Shang Xueli nodded in understanding. "Big Sis Yao’s past identity was Guang Zhiyi, and she was truly powerful."

"Whether in the past or the present, Senior Feng Yao is still too strong." Shang Xueli agreed with Gu Yanshu. "By the way, Shang Jingyuan is the fifth strongest cultivator on the list, and he is the most ruthless among them."
Shang Xueli and Shang Luohu looked at Gu Yanshu seriously. "Please tell us about him, Senior Gu."

"Shang Jingyuan was self-centered and obsessed with power, and he also didn’t hesitate to sacrifice members of his race in exchange for power." Gu Yanshu told them many things about the Asura Demon God of the Ancient Realm, which shocked them. "Honestly, I was hesitant to accept all of you in our territory because I am quite familiar with him, but I changed my mind after seeing you guys. Although I don’t know Shan Zhanluo yet, I know that he is different from Shang Jingyuan."

Shang Xueli spoke. "My father would never sacrifice his family for power, Senior Gu. In the past, he handed me to Mo Shentian to marry his son, but he didn’t do it for power. He did it to protect our race, so I never blamed him."
"Oh? If I’m not mistaken, Mo Shentian is a Celestial Demon, right?"

"That’s right." Shang Xuelin nodded. "In the past, Mo Shentian was the strongest among the ten demon gods, and my father couldn’t defeat him, even after he used his strengthening technique. He threatened my father to destroy our race, but he would spare our race if my father handed me over to him. Since my father had no other choice, he handed me over to him, and I spent hundreds of years in misery."
"Xueli." Shang Luohu called softly, her eyes welling up with tears. Although her daughter had returned, she still regretted it, but she and her husband were powerless to stop Mo Shentian.

"I have already said that I never blamed the two of you, Mother. Although I suffered in the past, I have found happiness now, so you should let go of the regret in your heart." After saying this to her mother, Shang Xueli looked at Gu Yanshu again. "Senior Gu, you are discussing this matter with us because you fear that Shang Jingyuan might discover our presence in this domain and attack us, right?"

Gu Yanshu nodded. "Actually, one of the demon gods in this domain has a good relationship with Shang Jingyuan, and he is on Huo Wuyan’s side. They hate my husband, and they are planning many things to bring him down. If they find out about the presence of members of your race in this domain, they will immediately tell him."

"I see." Shang Xueli nodded in understanding. "Honestly, you don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan, Senior Gu. If he comes here and attacks us, my husband will act against him, and this domain will be his grave."

Gu Yanshu had heard about Zhang Fei’s battle with Meng Huo, and she also knew quite a bit about him, including his relationship with Feng Yao. She had no doubts about his abilities, and she believed he could defeat Shang Jingyuan. However, she still harbored some concerns about the Asura Demon God of the Paradise Realm, especially his connections with many powerful cultivators.
Gun Yanshu sighed. "Xueli, Shang Jingyuan has many powerful allies, and some of them are cultivators on the ten strongest list, one of which is Xing Zhixun."
"Is Xing Zhixun stronger than Big Sis Yao?"
"Impossible." Gu Yanshu shook her head vigorously. "Senior Feng was the strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm in the past, but—"

"Then, it’s no big deal." Shang Xueli interrupted her. "Big Sis Yao and Big Sis Ling are always by my husband’s side, so I don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan and Xing Zhixun. If they dare to come here and target my family, I believe he will not remain silent, and he might even kill them."
"Alright." Gu Yanshu let out a soft sigh and stood up. "You two just arrived here; I won’t bother you any further. You can freely explore this city and get used to it."
"Thank you, Senior Gu."
After Gu Yanshu left, Shang Xueli immediately spoke to her mother. "Mother, you don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan and Xing Zhixun; my husband will definitely protect us from them."
"I know." Shang Luohu always believed in Zhang Fei. "Are you going to be in seclusion again?"

Shang Xueli nodded. "My husband has big plans for our future, Mother. I can’t slack off, and I have to catch up with others. I will stay here and accompany you for the next few days, and I will enter seclusion again after that."
"Okay."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to the fifth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss domain. He had also brought Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei back there.
Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei informed him about the situation of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, and the Seven Emotion Demon Race.
"Thank you both for your help."

Hua Qianmei spoke again. "Mo Qingwen and I are worried that Shang Jingyuan will find out about the presence of Shang Zhanluo and his family in the Capital City, and he might come here to capture them."
"Which among those demon gods is related to Shang Jingyuan?"

"The Tyrant Demon God, Baili Qiongyu." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when Hua Qianmei presented her image. "In fact, he is the second strongest demon god after Mo Qingwen, and he has long harbored the ambition to surpass him. He has a good relationship with Shang Jingyuan, and he will definitely tell him about the presence of Shang Zhanluo and the others in this domain."
"By the way, Shang Jingyuan and Baili Qiongyu are ranked fifth and sixth on the list of strongest cultivators," Gongsun Zhilan added.

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "Zhilan, I am not even afraid of Meng Huo and Jiu Tou Sen, so why should I be afraid of them? If they dare attack my in-laws, I will teach them a lesson they will never forget for the rest of their lives. Alright, you two don’t need to worry about those two people, and I will protect my in-laws myself."
After that, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan said nothing else and started hunting those mindless demons again with Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei was with several women in the main bedroom. They were his servants from the Nine Stars Realm: Huan Ya, Gu Hanshuang, Dan Qinying, and Ximen Yueliang.
In the past, Huan Ya, Gu Hanshuang, and Dan Qinying were humans, but Zhang Fei turned them into female demons according to their request.
After discussing some matters with them, Zhang Fei began dual cultivation with them, and they spent several days together—the equivalent of two days in the outside world.
After completing their seclusion, the four women immediately went to the training ground to continue their training.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei checked on Ru Xue, who was still evolving. She had been evolving for nine months based on outside time, but she still needed more time to complete the process.

After that, Zhang Fei continued his seclusion with Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu. Both women had originally been ordinary Heavenly Foxes, but they turned into Demon Heavenly Foxes after he took them to the Nine Hell Darkland.
Zhang Fei didn’t spend too much time with the two women, and they ended their seclusion the next two days, but they still did it for a few days in the pavilion.
