"By the way, Long Yunxi is a demihuman and inherited the sky dragon bloodline; she has been living with us in my husband’s private place for a month and a half, and she is still there to this day."
Gu Yanshu wasn’t surprised to hear that from Shang Xueli because Mo Qingwen had already told her, but Shang Luohu was even more shocked about Zhang Fei’s relationship with those cultivators.
"Why do you ask that, Mother?"
Shang Luohu took a deep breath.
"Senior Gu previously mentioned the ten strongest cultivators, and it has something to do with the Asura Demon God from this Ancient Realm."
"Hmm?" Shang Xueli looked at Gu Yanshu with a questioning look.
"Your mother is right, Xueli." Gu Yanshu nodded.
"In the past, there were ten strongest cultivators in this Ancient Realm, but six of them are now dead, and one of them is Senior Feng Yao."
Shang Xueli nodded in understanding.
"Big Sis Yao’s past identity was Guang Zhiyi, and she was truly powerful."
"Whether in the past or the present, Senior Feng Yao is still too strong." Shang Xueli agreed with Gu Yanshu.
"By the way, Shang Jingyuan is the fifth strongest cultivator on the list, and he is the most ruthless among them."
Shang Xueli and Shang Luohu looked at Gu Yanshu seriously.
"Please tell us about him, Senior Gu."

"Shang Jingyuan was self-centered and obsessed with power, and he also didn’t hesitate to sacrifice members of his race in exchange for power." Gu Yanshu told them many things about the Asura Demon God of the Ancient Realm, which shocked them.
"Honestly, I was hesitant to accept all of you in our territory because I am quite familiar with him, but I changed my mind after seeing you guys.
Although I don’t know Shan Zhanluo yet, I know that he is different from Shang Jingyuan."
Shang Xueli spoke.
"My father would never sacrifice his family for power, Senior Gu.
In the past, he handed me to Mo Shentian to marry his son, but he didn’t do it for power.
He did it to protect our race, so I never blamed him."
"Oh?
If I’m not mistaken, Mo Shentian is a Celestial Demon, right?"
"That’s right." Shang Xuelin nodded.
"In the past, Mo Shentian was the strongest among the ten demon gods, and my father couldn’t defeat him, even after he used his strengthening technique.
He threatened my father to destroy our race, but he would spare our race if my father handed me over to him.
Since my father had no other choice, he handed me over to him, and I spent hundreds of years in misery."
"Xueli." Shang Luohu called softly, her eyes welling up with tears.
Although her daughter had returned, she still regretted it, but she and her husband were powerless to stop Mo Shentian.
"I have already said that I never blamed the two of you, Mother.
Although I suffered in the past, I have found happiness now, so you should let go of the regret in your heart." After saying this to her mother, Shang Xueli looked at Gu Yanshu again.
"Senior Gu, you are discussing this matter with us because you fear that Shang Jingyuan might discover our presence in this domain and attack us, right?"
Gu Yanshu nodded.
"Actually, one of the demon gods in this domain has a good relationship with Shang Jingyuan, and he is on Huo Wuyan’s side.
They hate my husband, and they are planning many things to bring him down.
If they find out about the presence of members of your race in this domain, they will immediately tell him."
"I see." Shang Xueli nodded in understanding.
"Honestly, you don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan, Senior Gu.
If he comes here and attacks us, my husband will act against him, and this domain will be his grave."
Gu Yanshu had heard about Zhang Fei’s battle with Meng Huo, and she also knew quite a bit about him, including his relationship with Feng Yao.
She had no doubts about his abilities, and she believed he could defeat Shang Jingyuan.
However, she still harbored some concerns about the Asura Demon God of the Paradise Realm, especially his connections with many powerful cultivators.
Gun Yanshu sighed.
"Xueli, Shang Jingyuan has many powerful allies, and some of them are cultivators on the ten strongest list, one of which is Xing Zhixun."
"Is Xing Zhixun stronger than Big Sis Yao?"
"Impossible." Gu Yanshu shook her head vigorously.
"Senior Feng was the strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm in the past, but—"
"Then, it’s no big deal." Shang Xueli interrupted her.
"Big Sis Yao and Big Sis Ling are always by my husband’s side, so I don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan and Xing Zhixun.
If they dare to come here and target my family, I believe he will not remain silent, and he might even kill them."
"Alright." Gu Yanshu let out a soft sigh and stood up.
"You two just arrived here; I won’t bother you any further.
You can freely explore this city and get used to it."
"Thank you, Senior Gu."
After Gu Yanshu left, Shang Xueli immediately spoke to her mother.
"Mother, you don’t need to worry about Shang Jingyuan and Xing Zhixun; my husband will definitely protect us from them."
"I know." Shang Luohu always believed in Zhang Fei.
"Are you going to be in seclusion again?"
Shang Xueli nodded.
"My husband has big plans for our future, Mother.
I can’t slack off, and I have to catch up with others.
I will stay here and accompany you for the next few days, and I will enter seclusion again after that."
"Okay."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to the fifth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss domain.
He had also brought Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei back there.
Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei informed him about the situation of the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, and the Seven Emotion Demon Race.
"Thank you both for your help."
Hua Qianmei spoke again.
"Mo Qingwen and I are worried that Shang Jingyuan will find out about the presence of Shang Zhanluo and his family in the Capital City, and he might come here to capture them."
"Which among those demon gods is related to Shang Jingyuan?"
"The Tyrant Demon God, Baili Qiongyu." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when Hua Qianmei presented her image.
"In fact, he is the second strongest demon god after Mo Qingwen, and he has long harbored the ambition to surpass him.
He has a good relationship with Shang Jingyuan, and he will definitely tell him about the presence of Shang Zhanluo and the others in this domain."
"By the way, Shang Jingyuan and Baili Qiongyu are ranked fifth and sixth on the list of strongest cultivators," Gongsun Zhilan added.
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly.
"Zhilan, I am not even afraid of Meng Huo and Jiu Tou Sen, so why should I be afraid of them?
If they dare attack my in-laws, I will teach them a lesson they will never forget for the rest of their lives.
Alright, you two don’t need to worry about those two people, and I will protect my in-laws myself."
After that, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan said nothing else and started hunting those mindless demons again with Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei was with several women in the main bedroom.
They were his servants from the Nine Stars Realm: Huan Ya, Gu Hanshuang, Dan Qinying, and Ximen Yueliang.
In the past, Huan Ya, Gu Hanshuang, and Dan Qinying were humans, but Zhang Fei turned them into female demons according to their request.
After discussing some matters with them, Zhang Fei began dual cultivation with them, and they spent several days together—the equivalent of two days in the outside world.
After completing their seclusion, the four women immediately went to the training ground to continue their training.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei checked on Ru Xue, who was still evolving.
She had been evolving for nine months based on outside time, but she still needed more time to complete the process.
After that, Zhang Fei continued his seclusion with Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu.
Both women had originally been ordinary Heavenly Foxes, but they turned into Demon Heavenly Foxes after he took them to the Nine Hell Darkland.
Zhang Fei didn’t spend too much time with the two women, and they ended their seclusion the next two days, but they still did it for a few days in the pavilion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1924: Long Yuxi Want To Spar I
paragraphs: After dual cultivating with Tian Jianxia and Tian Gongzhu, Zhang Fei took Bai Shushi and Bai Tian’er to the main bedroom.
Bai Shushi and Bai Tian’er were another mother-daughter pair, yet they possessed opposite personalities.
Although they had long been Zhang Fei’s wives, Bai Shushi maintained her shyness, unlike Bai Tian’er, who had become increasingly brazen.
Ever since Zhang Fei first met Bai Tian’er in the Xian Imperial Sect in the Nine Star Realm, she had already shown her vulgar side, and she repeatedly teased him.
The first time they intimated was at the Star Tower, precisely when they were resting in the rest area.
Back then, Zhang Fei didn’t like Bai Tian’er’s character, so he never thought of taking her as his wife, which frustrated her for a long time.

Zhang Fei accepted Bai Tian’er as his woman several months after he liberated the Bai Kingdom from Li Tiannan and Huangfu Shou, and they officially became husband and wife after ascending to the Paradise Realm.
As for Bai Shushi, Zhang Fei was attracted to her from their first meeting, and he used some underhanded tactics against her. In the end, his plan worked, and he took her to his training space.
However, Bai Shushi didn’t immediately agree to become Zhang Fei’s wife because she knew her daughter’s feelings; she didn’t want to see her daughter suffer because of their relationship.
After Zhang Fei accepted her daughter as his woman, Bai Shushi and Bai Tian’er dual-cultivated with him at the same time, and they became his wives from then on.
Even though she had to wait months to become Zhang Fei’s wife, Bai Tian’er felt extraordinary joy as soon as she accepted her.

"You must be thinking about doing something perverted with me and my mother, Husband." Bai Tian’er walked in front of Zhang Fei as she removed her dresses one by one, and her naked body was displayed in front of his eyes moments later.
Zhang Fei pulled Bai Tian’er into his lap and kissed her. "I was remembering my first meeting with you and your mother, Tian’er."
"Ugh." Bai Tian’er’s eyes twitched as her past memories resurfaced. She recalled Zhang Fei’s past rejections, which had left her saddened for quite some time.
Even after they shared intimate moments at the Star Tower, Zhang Fei was unwilling to accept Bai Tian’er, forcing her to wait a long time to become his wife.
To make matters worse, Zhang Fei approached Bai Shushi and took her to his training space earlier than Bai Tian’er, further drowning her in disappointment.
Zhang Fei sighed and rubbed her cheeks. "I’m sorry, Tian’er."

"No need." Bai Tian’er shook her head. "I knew you weren’t willing to accept me back then because I was too flirtatious, so I blamed myself for that. Even though I had to wait a long time, I finally found my happiness. Not only did I become your wife, but you also gave me many valuable opportunities to improve myself. The only thing missing from my life is a child, but I know you aren’t ready for one yet, so I will wait until you are fully ready."
Zhang Fei nodded with a smile. "When I’m ready to be a father, I will impregnate you and your mother, and you two will bear several children for me in the future."

"I don’t want to have lots of children, Husband." Bai Shushi took off her white dress as she walked towards them. "I already have a daughter, so I want to have a son with you, and two children are enough for me."

Zhang Fei pulled Bai Shushi to sit on his lap and kissed her. "Since you only want to have one child with me, I won’t force you to give birth to more than one. However, I want to have at least two children with your daughter, and you will have two grandchildren."

"I feel like our relationship will be strange in the future, husband," Bai Tian’er agreed with Bai Shushi. "Your children with my daughter will be my grandchildren, and your children with me will be her half-siblings."
"Haha." "At least the relationship between the three of us won’t be as strange as my relationship with Chen’er, Yi’er, Yue’er, and Lin’er, right?"

Bai Tian’er and Bai Shushi were stunned for a moment, thinking about that. Zhang Fei’s relationship with Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin was the most peculiar compared to his relationship with the two of them or with his other wives.

"Alright, you two don’t need to think about my relationship with the four of them." Zhang Fei laid Bai Shushi on the bed, with Bai Tian’er lying on top of her. "Even though my relationship with them is strange, it’s not a big deal for us. "Chen’er, Yue’er, and Lin’er have turned into beasts, so our relationship has changed since then. As for Yi’er, I will also change her into a female beast in the future, and everything will be fine."
Bai Shusi hugged her daughter and asked. "Does that mean the blood relationship between the four of you has disappeared?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded. "I’ve checked their bodies in the past, and they’ve changed since they became female beasts, including the blood relationship between us. For now, Qing Yi is still human, but I’ll turn her into a female beast too if I find a suitable one."
"Oh." Bai Shushi nodded as she remembered Zhang Fei’s science capsule. "How long will we be in seclusion, husband?"
"As long as you wish."

Bai Tian’er and Bai Shushi exchanged glances; they wanted to have a long isolation with Zhang Fei, but they realized their bodies and stamina were no match for him. Even if all his wives were gathered together and served him at the same time, he always exhausted them.
"We—Ahh..."
The two women groaned as soon as Zhang Fei touched their pussies, and they hurriedly released both of their souls to dual-soul cultivation with his.
After their souls started their dual-soul cultivation, they immediately started their sexual activities, and they did it for several days nonstop in the main bedroom.
When Bai Tian’er and Bai Shushi were exhausted, Zhang Fei summoned Han Yuanzhi to join them.

Just like Bai Tian’er and Bai Shushi, Zhang Fei met Han Yuanzhi in the Nine Stars Realm, and her Han Clan was part of the Bai Kingdom. Back then, he approached her because he needed her yin qi, and she agreed to become his woman after he gave her some pills. Moreover, he also helped her clan members, and her niece became a cook in one of his restaurants.

After Zhang Fei finished dual cultivating with the three women, he asked them to continue their practice and summoned several other women to come to him. They were Shang Ziyuan, Fei Qinyuan, and Murong Qianying.
Fei Qinyuan was the former mistress of the Shang Clan in the Red Sun Realm; Zhang Fei took her as his servant after killing her husband, Shang Huaqiang.

Shang Ziyuan was Fei Qinyuan’s sister-in-law and the younger sister of the late Shang Huaqiang. Zhang Fei captured her after she tried to attack Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, and she has been his servant ever since.

Although Murong Qianying was the mother of Shang Yaolin and Shang Yumei, Zhang Fei never considered her a member of his main harem, even though he frequently dual cultivated with her using his true body.

In the past, Murong Qianying tried to capture Zhang Fei when he disguised himself as a ten-year-old boy in the Wasteland Realm. However, he discovered her plans and turned the situation around, and she became his woman from then on.
Unlike her two daughters, Murong Qianying didn’t have deep feelings for Zhang Fei, and she only needed sexual satisfaction.

Zhang Fei had no issue with that, as his cultivation level was still low at the time, and he had not yet reached the Seven Divine Realms. Consequently, he treated Murong Qianying differently than his two daughters.

Four days had passed in the outside world since Zhang Fei engaged in dual cultivation with the six women. He chose to rest before continuing dual cultivation with his other wives, and he went to the training ground to practice.
"Hey." Zhang Fei turned to Long Yunxi, the female demihuman with the sky dragon bloodline. "You’re finally out! I’ve been waiting for you for a long time!"
Zhang Fei smiled playfully. "If you want to meet me, you can enter the pavilion."
"Humph!" Long Yuxi snorted. "I will never set foot inside your pavilion, or I will see your indecent acts with all your wives!"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Honestly, I don’t have a demihuman wife, and you quite attract my attention, so—"

"Stop!" Long Yunxi waved both hands. "I admit that you are different from other living creatures, but I am not interested in being your woman. By the way, I’ve been training here for several months, so I’d like to spar with you to test my progress."
"I see." Zhang Fei glanced at the people training on the grounds. "This place is crowded, and our sparring would affect them, so we’ll spar inside my residence."
"Huh?" Long Yunxi crossed her arms over her chest. "You must be thinking of doing something else to me, right?"

Zhang Fei’s lips twitched. "Do you think I’m that lowly? If I wanted to do something to you, I could have done it since you watched me dual cultivate with Yue Xuelian in the underground ice cave, and you couldn’t refuse me."
"Hmm?" Ling Yuxi narrowed her eyes, looking at Zhang Fei warily. "Fine, we’ll spar at your residence, but I’ll beat you up for real if you dare do anything indecent to me."
"Up to you." Zhang Fei shrugged and turned around. "Let’s go."

chapters.title: Chapter 1925: Long Yuxi Want To Spar II
paragraphs: Inside the pavilion.

Zhang Fei stood on one side; he transformed into a half-dragon form. Two dragon horns appeared above his head, and dragon scales covered his arms, shoulders, chest, and legs, while his hands became dragon claws. A long tail moved slowly behind him.

Long Yunxi stood in front of Zhang Fei with a fascinated look, even though she had already seen his half-dragon form when they first met. She liked his current form more than his human form or any of his other forms. Her heart pounded every time she saw him in this form.
After all, Long Yunxi was a dragon demihuman, and Zhang Fei’s half-dragon form perfectly matched her.
They looked at each other, but neither of them spoke.
Long Yunxi lowered her center of gravity, and Zhang Fei did the same. The next instant, both disappeared from their original positions; their feet struck the floor almost at the same time.
*Bang*
Zhang Fei’s right fist shot toward Long Yunxi’s chest, but she turned her body sideways to avoid it.
Long Yunxi swiftly stepped inside his reach and directed her fist toward Zhang Fei’s ribs, but he twisted his waist, and her attack struck his side but failed to move him.
Zhang Fei’s dragon tail suddenly swept across the floor, targeting her legs, but Long Yunxi jumped over it. Before she could land, he moved beneath her and launched an attack at her chest.
Long Yunxi crossed both arms in front of her chest and blocked Zhang Fei’s attack.
*Bang*

The impact of Zhang Fei’s fist caused Long Yunxi to roll through the air. She landed lightly on both feet, sliding only half a step before stopping. "Your blow just now was abnormal, and the pressure of your attack was equivalent to a cultivator at the Celestial God Realm."

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed, squeezed his right hand, and twisted his fist. "As you already know, I have mastered many body techniques, so my physical strength is already far above any cultivator. Moreover, I am currently using my half-dragon form, and it enhances my physical strength even more."
Zhang Fei charged forward again, but this time Long Yunxi didn’t retreat. She charged straight at him; their fists collided, and their arms shook from the impact.
*Bang*
Zhang Fei shifted slightly to the side, used his right elbow, and aimed it at Long Yunxi’s head. She raised her arm, blocked his elbow, and retaliated by aiming her knee at his stomach.
Zhang Fei smiled and caught Long Yunxi’s knee using his other hand, making her grit her teeth.

Long Yunxi rotated her waist and launched a kick with her other leg, but Zhang Fei swiftly released his grip on the woman’s knee and leaned back. He caught her ankle as it passed right in front of his face.
Instead of backing away, Long Yunxi leaped and spun her body; her other leg swept toward Zhang Fei’s head, but he released her ankle and ducked to dodge her attack.
Long Yunxi’s leg passed over his head, but Zhang Fei moved quickly and grabbed her waist.
Long Yunxi’s eyes twitched; she struck his shoulder using her elbow, but Zhang Fei moved faster and blocked it.
Zhang Fei tightened his grip on her waist and lifted her off the ground, but Long Yunxi immediately sprang into action. She wrapped one arm around his neck and hooked one leg around his waist.
"Hey... Hey... Do you realize that our position is quite intimate now?" Zhang Fei teased her.
Long Yuxi’s face flushed, realizing the strangeness of their position. She used her tail to attack him, but Zhang Fei moved his tail and coiled it around hers. "Ugh! Get your tail off me!"
"I can’t do that." Zhang Fei tilted Long Yunxi’s body, lowered his head, and quickly kissed the muzzle of her dragon head.

chapters.title: Chapter 1926: Baili Qiongyu I
paragraphs: Huo Wuyan looked at the male demon god named Huyan Jingrui. "Old Baili has already contacted Shang Jingyuan, and that demon maniac is heading straight here."
"Oh?" Huyan Jingrui and the other two raised their eyebrows. "When will Shang Jingyuan arrive in our domain?"
"If my calculations are correct, he will arrive in two weeks. However, his arrival will cause a lot of trouble, and Mo Qingwen will move to stop him."

"Hahaha," Gui Ye laughed as he slammed the table. "Isn’t that a good thing, Old Huyan? If Mo Qingwen fights with Shang Jingyuan, we can use that opportunity to get rid of him, and we will take over this domain from him."
Huo Wuyan and Huyan Jingrui agreed with Gui Ye, and Baili Qiongyu had already planned to use Shang Jingyuan to smooth their plan to overthrow Mo Qingwen.

"Who will become the leader of this domain after we defeat Mo Qingwen?" The three of them turned to the fourth male demon god named Mao Yifan; they frowned as they knew each other’s ambitions, and they hoped to become the next leader. "Does Old Baili want to be our leader? Honestly, I don’t agree if he wants to replace Mo Qingwen, and our domain will be in chaos if he becomes the new leader."

Huo Wuyan, Huyan Jingrui, and Gui Ye agreed with Mao Yifan. They needed Baili Qiongyu to overthrow Mo Qingwen, but they also wouldn’t agree to him becoming their domain’s next leader. However, they realized that their strength was inferior to his, and they wouldn’t be able to stop him if he wanted to ascend the throne, which put them at a crossroads.

Huo Wuyan repeatedly tapped his finger on his armrest while thinking, but he couldn’t think of a proper way to prevent Baili Qiongyu from ascending the throne. If he ascended the throne and became the new leader of their domain, he would abuse his authority to suppress all the demon race.

Although Mo Qingwen had also treated them similarly, he wasn’t a tyrant, and he used gentler methods to rule their domain. However, Baili Qiongyu was different; he would use any means necessary to force them into submission, leaving them worried about their future.
Gui Ye suddenly had an idea. "What if we pit Old Baili against Zhang Fei? However, we should do it after we overthrow Mo Qingwen, so we can eliminate two threats at the same time."
Huyan Jingrui and Mao Yifan agreed with Gui Ye’s idea, but Huo Wuyan had different thoughts from them.
Mo Qingge is stronger than Baili Qiongyu, and he isn’t confident that the Tyrant Demon God can defeat him by himself, but the result will be different if Shang Jingyuan is willing to help him.

Huo Wuyan shook his head and spoke. "We should not discuss this matter for now, and we must wait for Old Baili to return to this domain first. If he succeeds in persuading Shang Jingyuan to help him, our chances of overthrowing Mo Qingwen will be wide open."

"I understand your thoughts, Old Huo." Mao Yifan said with a nod. "If Shang Jingyuan is willing to help us overthrow Mo Qingwen, we don’t need to fight on the front lines. We should let him and Old Baili fight Mo Qingwen first, and we’ll look for an opportunity to eliminate the latter after their fight."
Huyan Jingrui then asked. "What do you think if Shang Jingyuan and Old Baili join forces against Mo Qingwen? Do you think they can defeat him?"

"Mo Qingwen is ranked third on the list of ten strongest cultivators in this Ancient Realm because he is indeed strong, and I’m sure their fight will be very fierce." Gui Ye looked at the three of them. "Honestly, our chances of defeating and overthrowing him are slim, but our chances might increase if Old Baili manages to persuade Shang Jingyuan. The Asura Demon God has a special strengthening technique that only members of his race can use, and his strength will increase significantly once he activates it."

Huyan Jingrui, Mao Yifan, and Huo Wuyan agreed with Gui Ye. They had already heard about Shang Jingyuan’s strength, and his strength helped him rank fifth on the list of ten strongest cultivators. Even though Mo Qingwen was ranked second, they were confident that the Asura Demon God and Baili Qiongyu could defeat him.
However, they also harbored worry in their hearts; they were afraid that Baili Qiongyu would turn against them, and they would never be able to defeat him.
If Baili Qiongyu decided to turn against them, the members of their races would live under his pressure, and their lives would be worse than when Mo Qingwen was their leader.

Huo Wuyan sighed as he stood up. "For now, we should return to our respective places and wait for Old Baili to arrive in three days. We will then go to his palace to meet him. By the way, Old Gui, you should go meet Zhuo Hentian and Chang Moyu and ask them to go with us that day."
"Alright." Gui Ye agreed. "I’ll go meet them after this, and the three of us will go together to Old Baili’s palace in three days."
"What about Yan Washeng?"

"Bah! Why are you thinking about him, Old Huyan?" Gui Ye shook his head. "That fool has already fallen into Zhang Fei’s hands, remember? If we tell him about our plan, he’ll spill everything to that brat, so there’s no need to talk about him anymore. By the way, I’ll be leaving right now, and we’ll meet again in three days."
After Gui Ye disappeared, Huo Wuyan and the other two demon gods also left the place.
Unbeknownst to them, Tang Zhiyao appeared there, but she was using her ethereal body because her real body was in the Myriad Abyss Dungeon.

Tang Zhiyao frowned after overhearing their previous conversation; she didn’t expect Baili Qiongyu to reveal Shang Zhanluo and the others’ presence in their domain to Shang Jingyuan. "I must inform my husband about this matter so he can prepare something to protect his in-laws."
On the fifth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss Domain, Tang Zhiyao moved before Zhang Fei [5] and recounted the results of the previous meeting between Huo Wuyan and the three demon gods.
"As expected." Hua Qianmei said while shaking her head. "What are your plans to secure your in-laws, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "I don’t need to do anything because Huo Ling will protect them, and I’ve already told her to eliminate anyone who dares attack them. Shang Jingyuan may be powerful, but he’s not her match, and she can kill him like an ant. However, I will forbid her from killing him because I need him for something else, so I will ask her to capture him alive."
"What are you going to do to him?" Gongsun Zhilan asked.

"Did you forget about Shang Xueli?" Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao immediately understood Zhang Fei [5]’s plan. "I can help her cultivation reach the Celestial Demon God in the future, but I can’t help her much with her demon rank. Since Shang Jingyuan came to this domain, I will ask Huo Ling to capture him, and I will use a special method to force him to pass on his power to my wife."

Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding. "If Shang Xueli inherits Shang Jingyuan’s cultivation and demon power, her cultivation and demon rank will increase greatly, and she will become one of the strongest among us."

"Isn’t that a wonderful opportunity for her?" Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao couldn’t help but smile. "A few months ago, I witnessed the former two Celestial Demon Gods passing on their cultivation and demon power to Mo Shentian, and he became the new Celestial Demon God thanks to that. If Shang Xueli inherits Shang Jingyuan’s cultivation and demon power, I believe she will also become the new Asura Demon God, and she will be even stronger than her father."
"Then, what are your plans for Baili Qiongyu?"

"Heh!" Zhang Fei [5] sneered. "Since Baili Qiongyu told Shang Jingyuan about the existence of my in-laws in this domain, I will never spare him. If one of my wives is willing, I will transform her into his demon race, and I will help her to inherit his strength."
Tang Zhiyao looked at him in confusion. "Aren’t you planning to turn them into beasts or demon beasts, husband?"

"Hehehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Have you forgotten about Ye Mingran and the other three, Zhiyao? They used to be demons, and I turned them into demon beasts, remember? After they transformed into demon beasts, they didn’t lose their original demon abilities, and they inherited the abilities of demon beasts."

"I see." Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding. "If one of them transforms into a member of Baili Qiongyu’s demon race, she will inherit his cultivation and demon rank, and she will be able to lead his demon race."
"That’s right."
"Are you going to make a move against Huyan Jingrui, Mao Yifan, Huo Wuyan, and Gui Ye?" Hua Qianmei asked again.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I don’t want to waste my time on them, and I’ll only make a move against them if they target those closest to me."
"Do you want to hear my opinion?"
"Sure."

"They may not be your enemies right now, but there is a possibility they will become a threat to those closest to you in the future." Zhang Fei [5] didn’t argue with Hua Qianmei. "Instead of waiting for them to pick a fight with your people, I think you should make a move against them first. That way, your people won’t be in danger, and you’ll also help Mo Qingwen at the same time."

"I agree with her," Gongsun Zhilan nodded. "You can transform your four wives into their demon races, and the four of them can also inherit their cultivation and demon ranks. Isn’t that a win-win solution?"

"That fool has already fallen into Zhang Fei’s hands, remember?
If we tell him about our plan, he’ll spill everything to that brat, so there’s no need to talk about him anymore.
By the way, I’ll be leaving right now, and we’ll meet again in three days."
After Gui Ye disappeared, Huo Wuyan and the other two demon gods also left the place.
Unbeknownst to them, Tang Zhiyao appeared there, but she was using her ethereal body because her real body was in the Myriad Abyss Dungeon.
Tang Zhiyao frowned after overhearing their previous conversation; she didn’t expect Baili Qiongyu to reveal Shang Zhanluo and the others’ presence in their domain to Shang Jingyuan.
"I must inform my husband about this matter so he can prepare something to protect his in-laws."
On the fifth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss Domain, Tang Zhiyao moved before Zhang Fei [5] and recounted the results of the previous meeting between Huo Wuyan and the three demon gods.
"As expected." Hua Qianmei said while shaking her head.
"What are your plans to secure your in-laws, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged.
"I don’t need to do anything because Huo Ling will protect them, and I’ve already told her to eliminate anyone who dares attack them.
Shang Jingyuan may be powerful, but he’s not her match, and she can kill him like an ant.
However, I will forbid her from killing him because I need him for something else, so I will ask her to capture him alive."
"What are you going to do to him?" Gongsun Zhilan asked.
"Did you forget about Shang Xueli?" Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao immediately understood Zhang Fei [5]’s plan.
"I can help her cultivation reach the Celestial Demon God in the future, but I can’t help her much with her demon rank.
Since Shang Jingyuan came to this domain, I will ask Huo Ling to capture him, and I will use a special method to force him to pass on his power to my wife."
Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding.
"If Shang Xueli inherits Shang Jingyuan’s cultivation and demon power, her cultivation and demon rank will increase greatly, and she will become one of the strongest among us."
"Isn’t that a wonderful opportunity for her?" Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao couldn’t help but smile.
"A few months ago, I witnessed the former two Celestial Demon Gods passing on their cultivation and demon power to Mo Shentian, and he became the new Celestial Demon God thanks to that.
If Shang Xueli inherits Shang Jingyuan’s cultivation and demon power, I believe she will also become the new Asura Demon God, and she will be even stronger than her father."
"Then, what are your plans for Baili Qiongyu?"
"Heh!" Zhang Fei [5] sneered.
"Since Baili Qiongyu told Shang Jingyuan about the existence of my in-laws in this domain, I will never spare him.
If one of my wives is willing, I will transform her into his demon race, and I will help her to inherit his strength."
Tang Zhiyao looked at him in confusion.
"Aren’t you planning to turn them into beasts or demon beasts, husband?"
"Hehehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"Have you forgotten about Ye Mingran and the other three, Zhiyao?
They used to be demons, and I turned them into demon beasts, remember?
After they transformed into demon beasts, they didn’t lose their original demon abilities, and they inherited the abilities of demon beasts."
"I see." Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding.
"If one of them transforms into a member of Baili Qiongyu’s demon race, she will inherit his cultivation and demon rank, and she will be able to lead his demon race."
"That’s right."
"Are you going to make a move against Huyan Jingrui, Mao Yifan, Huo Wuyan, and Gui Ye?" Hua Qianmei asked again.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head.
"I don’t want to waste my time on them, and I’ll only make a move against them if they target those closest to me."
"Do you want to hear my opinion?"
"Sure."
"They may not be your enemies right now, but there is a possibility they will become a threat to those closest to you in the future." Zhang Fei [5] didn’t argue with Hua Qianmei.
"Instead of waiting for them to pick a fight with your people, I think you should make a move against them first.
That way, your people won’t be in danger, and you’ll also help Mo Qingwen at the same time."
"I agree with her," Gongsun Zhilan nodded.
"You can transform your four wives into their demon races, and the four of them can also inherit their cultivation and demon ranks.
Isn’t that a win-win solution?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1927: Baili Qiongyu II
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] had long considered the matter, but not all his wives were willing to transform into demons. Some of them were willing to transform into beasts, but they were unwilling to transform into demon beasts.
All his wives from Earth, Qing Yi, Guo Lan, Wang Zhuxian, and Ming Yanyu, were still humans.
From the Sky Jade Realm, Liu Hua, Chu Xing, Chu Qing, Ye Lian, Wen Xuan, Wen Yuan, Lian Xing, Lin Dong’er, Mu Lingshu, and Chang Wenjie had also said that they were unwilling to turn into demons.

Likewise, women from the Nine Stars Realm such as Yun Xinyue, Zhou Shenxin, Xian Changyue, Helian Yueyi, Huangfu Xiaoying, Huangfu Xiaomei, Bai Shushi, Bai Tian’er, and Han Yuanzhi were also still humans.
Among Zhang Fei [5]’s wives from the Red Sun Realm, Shang Yaolin, Murong Mengying, and Xi Yinying were also still humans.
Wang Yourou and Wei Xiaoya, who came from the Xianjin Realm and the Grand Royal Realm, once strongly refused his idea.
Shangguan Yan, Duanmu Luolan, and Yuan Tianling were willing to transform into beasts, but not demons or demon beasts, so the only one left was Leng Yueyan.

Among the women from the Paradise Realm, a few of them were still humans like Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, and Yue Ningxue. The rest are winged races, beasts, demons, and demon beasts.
As for Puyang Yeyu, Zhang Fei [5] never offered her the chance to become a demon or demon beast because her stance was clear: she would not be willing to transform into one of them.
Zhang Fei [5] thought of some of his servants, such as Chu Youqian, Xing Mei, Yi Na, Shang Ziyuan, Fei Qinyuan, Murong Qianying, and Sima Huiqing.
Zhang Fei [5] sighed. “I’ll discuss this matter with them first, but I’ll never force them if they don’t want to turn into demons.”
Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao said nothing more and waited for Zhang Fei [5] to speak with them first. After that, they continued hunting those mindless demons again.
A day passed in the outside world—equivalent to several days in the training space.

After training with those people for several days, Zhang Fei decided to stop and returned to the pavilion. He gathered Chu Youqian, Xing Mei, Yi Na, Shang Ziyuan, Fei Qinyuan, Murong Qianying, and Sima Huiqing to discuss Hua Qianmei’s previous idea.
The seven women exchanged looks of shock after Zhang Fei explained everything; they felt a dilemma about turning into female demons.
Sima Huiqing stepped forward. “What demon races do they come from, husband?”

“I don’t know the identities of the other three yet, but Gui Ye is the Ghost Demon God and Baili Qiongyu is the Tyrant Demon God. According to Tang Zhiyao and the others, both of them are powerful, especially Baili Qiongyu.” Zhang Fei looked at her. “Are you interested in transforming into one of their demon races, Huiqing? If you’re willing to transform into a demon, I’ll help you transform into a demon beast in the future. That way, your cultivation will skyrocket, and you’ll gain the abilities of both races.”
“Can you really turn us into demons, husband? As far as I remember, you’ve only ever turned humans into demon beasts, right?” Murong Qianying asked.
Zhang Fei shook his head. “You’re wrong about that, Qianying. Yun Kexin, Gu Yan, and a few others aren’t demon beasts, remember? They used to be humans, and I turned them into demons.”
The seven women remembered that Gu Yan turned into an Infernal Demon, Yun Kexin turned into a Lust Demon, and Xi Zihua turned into a Crysalith Ice Demon, including several other women.
“Does that mean we might turn into something like Ye Mingran and the others in the future?”
Zhang Fei nodded at Xing Mei. “However, I won’t rush to turn you into demon beasts; I’ll look for the most suitable ones for you first.”
“A demon with ghost abilities is quite interesting, husband.” Fei Qinyuan said. “Moreover, none of us have that kind of ability yet, right?”
“Yes.” Zhang Fei looked at Fei Qinyuan. “Are you interested in becoming Gui Ye’s demon race, Qinyuan?”
Fei Qinyuan nodded slightly. “I think ghost abilities will be useful in the future, so I’m interested in it.”
“Are you sure about that?”
“I’m sure.”
“Alright.” Zhang Fei looked at the others. “Who among the six of you wants to transform into Baili Qiongyu’s tyrant demon race?”
“Can I?” Chu Youqian raised her hand. Among Zhang Fei’s women, she was one of the weakest, so she wanted to use this opportunity to strengthen herself, and she would be more useful to him.

Zhang Fei stared at Chu Youqian for a moment before nodding. “Alright, I will transform you into his demon race later, Youqian. Right now, Baili Qiongyu is on his way back to the Myriad Abyss Domain and will arrive in two days. Once he gets here, I will capture him, and you can undergo the process then.”
“Okay.” Chu Youqian nodded smilingly.

In the past, Chu Youqian had a better chance with Zhang Fei because she was a member of the Chu Clan. Unfortunately, she made a foolish mistake, so he captured her and imprisoned her in the Yin-Yang Space for decades.

Back then, Zhang Fei wanted to release her and send her back to the Sky Jade Realm, but Chu Youqian chose to stay by his side and become his servant. Despite her servant status, she gradually adapted and grew to enjoy her new role.
“Alright, you guys can continue cultivating or training, and I will dual cultivate with the others first.”
The seven women didn’t linger there. Some of them returned to their rooms to cultivate, while others went to the training ground to train with the others.
After they left, Zhang Fei returned to the main bedroom and summoned several of his wives to meet him.
In a short while, Huli Haohao, Huli Zhishen, Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, Yan Jinwu, and Long Zhenxia entered the room.
Among the six of them, five women came from the Sky Dragon Island, and only Huli Zhishen came from the Golden Fox Realm.
Huli Haohao immediately jumped into his lap and hugged his neck. “Hey, husband! Are you interested in one of the women from the Snow Fox Race?”

“No.” Zhang Fei shook his head. “If I were interested in any of them, I would have taken her as my woman when Huli Zhishen brought their race to our sect. The women of the Snow Fox Race are beautiful, but I already have several beautiful female foxes by my side.”
Huli Haohao puffed out her chest, making her big breasts stand out. “You are sensible, husband! Ancestor Zhishen and I are already this beautiful and sexy, so you should be satisfied with us.”
“Hahaha,” Zhang Fei laughed and pinched her cheeks. “You’re beautiful and sexy, but Shang Yumei and Huli Yaohu are much sexier than you, remember?”
“Ugh.” Huli Haohao couldn’t refute Zhang Fei’s words. In terms of beauty, she wasn’t inferior to Shang Yumei and Huli Yaohu, but she had to admit they were sexier than her, especially the latter.
“Why don’t you invite them to join us, husband?” Huli Zhishen asked, sitting beside Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei shook his head. “I will dual cultivate with them later, and I want to focus on you guys for now.”
Yan Jinwu sat in the empty chair across from them. “How long will we be in seclusion, Husband?”
Feng Qingmeng, Zhu Lingyao, and Long Zhenxia perked up and looked at Zhang Fei.
“Hahaha! Why do you guys look so excited?” Zhang Fei asked with an amused smile. “Since there are six of you now, we will dual cultivate until you guys are satisfied.”
“Ahh!” Long Zhenxia suddenly screamed as Feng Qingmeng tore off her red dress. “Ugh! Why did you tear my dress, Big Sis Qingmeng?”
Feng Qingmeng shrugged. “Since you’re the youngest among us, you should dual cultivate with our husband first, and you can buy a new dress later.”
“Huh?” Long Zhenxia pointed to Huli Zhishen. “Why not Ancestor Zhishen first? She is the most senior among us, so she should take the first turn.”

“Alright, you don’t have to argue with us, Zhenxia.” Huli Zhishen pulled Huli Haohao down from Zhang Fei’s lap, and they walked to the empty chairs on the side of the bedroom. “You can start dual cultivating with him first, and we will wait for you to finish.”
“Come here, Zhenxia.” Long Zhenxia walked over to Zhang Fei and sat on his lap. “Hey! We’ve been husband and wife for decades; why are you still so shy?”
Long Zhenxia pouted her lips. “My character has always been shy like this, right? Even though we have been husband and wife for decades, I can’t change my hundreds of years of character.”
“Haha.” Zhang Fei laid Long Zhenxia on the bed, crawled on top of her, and transformed into his half-dragon form. “Aren’t you going to transform into your half-dragon form?”

Long Zhenxia exhaled softly and transformed into her half-dragon form, making their appearances quite contrasting. Her dragon race was a flame dragon, and her half-dragon form was red, whereas Zhang Fei’s half-dragon form was black. “By the way, husband, I want to visit my parents in the upper realm after our seclusion. Is that okay?”

“They are our parents, so you don’t need to ask my permission to visit them, and you can go there whenever you want.” Zhang Fei paused. “Zhenxia, I can’t accompany you to visit them, so I need you to persuade them to move to the Paradise Realm.”

Long Zhenxia has long wanted her parents to move to the Paradise Realm, but they never agreed, and they wanted to spend their lives in the Three Mortal Realms. “I’ll try to talk to them, but I’m not sure they’ll agree to move, husband.”
“I will give you some items later, and you can give them to our parents.”
“Okay.”
